title: Werkstudent Audit Capture & AI Solutions (m/w/d) in Berlin
description:
Deloitte bietet führende Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting und Advisory - für nahezu 90 % der Fortune Global 500® und zahlreiche private Unternehmen. Wir liefern innovative Denkansätze, lösen komplexe Herausforderungen und fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum. Mit rund 470.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit eröffnen wir hervorragende Karrierechancen - getragen von einem starken „Wir“ und einer Vielfalt an Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten.
  
  
Du willst im Bereich
**Audit & Assurance – Audit Capture**
strategisch wichtige Projekte von der Identifikation bis hin zur Präsentation begleiten? Unser Team sorgt für maximale Gewinnchancen und schafft die Rahmenbedingungen für eine nachhaltige Marktpräsenz. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als
**Werkstudent Audit Capture & AI Solutions (m/w/d).**
Standorte:
**Frankfurt (Main)**
**, Berlin**
**, Düsseldorf**
**und München**
.
  
  
**Dein Impact:**
Als Werkstudent Audit Capture & AI Solutions (m/w/d) unterstützt du unser Team bei der Weiterentwicklung datengetriebener und AI-gestützter Lösungen für die strategische Geschäftsentwicklung.
  
  

* AI & Prompt Engineering: Du entwickelst und optimierst Prompts für Microsoft Copilot und weitere AI-Anwendungen. Dabei unterstützt du die Automatisierung von Analysen, Recherchen, Präsentationen und Entscheidungsgrundlagen.
* Datenanalyse & Insights: Du analysierst Unternehmens-, Markt- und Wettbewerbsdaten, identifizierst relevante Trends und leitest daraus Handlungsempfehlungen für das Management ab.
* Automatisierung: Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung automatisierter Workflows mit Microsoft Power Automate, Power Platform und weiteren digitalen Tools, um Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten.
* Data Management: Du wirkst bei der Strukturierung, Qualitätssicherung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Datenbestände und Intelligence-Datenbanken mit und schaffst die Basis für fundierte Entscheidungen.
* Reporting & Management Support: Du erstellst KPI-basierte Reports, Dashboards und Management-Präsentationen und unterstützt bei strategischen Projekten des Geschäftsbereichs Audit & Assurance.

**Dein Skillset:**

* Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Betriebswirtschaft, Volkswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs
* Sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse (v. a. Word, Excel, PowerPoint), idealerweise erste Erfahrungen mit Power BI, Power Automate oder Power Platform
* Interesse an Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI und Prompt Engineering, im besten Fall erste Kenntnisse im Einsatz mit Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT oder ähnlichen AI-Anwendungen
* Analytisches Denkvermögen sowie Interesse an Datenmanagement, Datenanalyse und digitalen Technologien
* Teamgeist, Begeisterung für Innovation sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

**Deine Chance:**

* Echte Verantwortung für eigene Aufgabenpakete innerhalb unserer Projekte, die du selbständig bearbeitest
* Persönliche:r Mentor:in in deinem Team, der/die dir mit Rat und Tat zur Seite steht und dich mit umfassendem Know-how unterstützt
* Ein chancenreiches und internationales Umfeld, das dir einmalige Einblicke in die Arbeit des weltweit größten Prüfungs- und Beratungsunternehmens bietet
* Work-Life-Balance in einem innovativen Unternehmensumfeld, das dir Gesundheitstage, Mitarbeiter:innen-Events und vieles mehr bietet
* Bereichsübergreifendes Networking im Deloitte Student Network mit exklusiven Vorträgen und regelmäßigem Austausch beim Praktikant:innen-Stammtisch
* Vielfältige Gestaltungsspielräume und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur – u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke

**Deine Verfügbarkeit:**
Als Werkstudent:in bist du ab sofort für bis zu 20 Stunden pro Woche verfügbar, wobei deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestaltet werden kann. In den Semesterferien sind nach Absprache bis zu 40 Stunden pro Woche möglich. Wir suchen Studierende für eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit für mindestens 1 Jahr.
  
  
**Bist du bereit? Mach mit uns den Unterschied!**
Unser Recruiting-Team freut sich auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen (CV sowie Abitur-, Hochschul- und Arbeitszeugnisse) über unser Online-Formular. Ein Anschreiben und ein Bewerbungsfoto sind bei uns nicht erforderlich.
  
  
**Gleiche Chancen für alle**
: Wir begrüßen ausdrücklich auch Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung.
**Noch Fragen?**
Alle Infos zu unserem Bewerbungsprozess findest du in unseren
**Bewerbungs-FAQs**
.
  
  
**Dein Kontakt bei Fragen rund um Karrierethemen**
Unser Team Talent Acquisition – Aleksandra, Anja, Julia, Lea, Lisa, Silja und ihre Teams – unterstützt dich gerne bei allen Fragen rund um deine Karriere bei Deloitte. Du erreichst uns per E-Mail unter career@deloitte.de oder telefonisch unter +49 211 87724111.

Collaborating in an international Berlin environment has also allowed me to work comfortably across languages, using my native Spanish, fluent English, and working German (B1).

What particularly excites me about Deloitte is the opportunity to bring this mix of analytical curiosity and builder execution to your team. Thank you very much for taking the time to review my application. I would welcome the chance to speak with you and discuss how my background can support Deloitte in this role.

title: Working Student, Offshore O&M Asset Management, Partner Management & Digitalization
description:
**Company:** Iberdrola Renovables Deutschland GmbH
  
**Location:** Berlin, Germany
  
**Working pattern:** Office-based
  
**Department:** Asset Management

  
  

**RESPONSIBILITIES AND FUNCTIONS**

  

The Working Student will support the Offshore O&M Asset Management team in:

  
  

* Support the collection, validation, and reporting of production and metering data for offshore wind assets.
* Support SAP-related activities, including purchase order tracking, invoice follow-up, approval workflows, and payment monitoring.
* Assist with budget preparation, forecasting activities, and cost tracking.
* Assist in the preparation of reports, presentations, procedures, and internal documentation.
* Contribute to the review and improvement of operational and commercial processes, including invoicing, metering, and revenue reporting.
* Perform data analysis, reconciliation, and quality checks across multiple information sources.
* Support special projects related to offshore wind operations, energy markets, business reporting, and process automation.
  

**PROFILE AND REQUIREMENTS**

  

* Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Economics, Business Administration, Energy Management, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
* Proactive attitude and willingness to learn.
* Fluent English.
* Availability to work from the Berlin office in accordance with the agreed working schedule.
  

**DESIRABLE SKILLS**

  

* Knowledge of SAP.
* Experience with Power BI, Power Query, VBA, Python, or automation tools.
* Interest in renewable energy and offshore wind.
* French, Spanish, or German language skills.
  

**WHAT WE OFFER**

  

* Join a global leader in renewable energy and play an active role in driving the energy transition.
* Gain valuable hands-on experience in an international and dynamic work environment.
* Attractive compensation for working students in line with market standards.
* Modern office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte with excellent public transport connections.
* Exclusive employee discounts with numerous partner companies across retail, travel, technology, and other industries.
  

  

**Mobility Information**

Please note that any applicant who is not a citizen of the country of the vacancy will be subject to compliance with the applicable immigration requirements to legally work in that country.

  
  

**Job Posting End Date:**

  
November-30-2026

title: German Speaking Process Operations Working Student (f/d/m)
description:
**Please note that this position is based in Berlin, Germany.**
**THE BEST WORK OF YOUR CAREER**
Trade Republic is the largest savings platform in Europe - we operate in 18 Countries, +10M Customers, 150B assets. But we're striving for more.
  
  
We have a bold mission to empower everyone to build wealth with easy, safe, and free access to financial systems. You will have the opportunity to grow your career by collaborating with a team of outstanding talents and state of the art technology to build a lasting, positive future for millions.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**
Our talented Product Operations experts are given the most complex, hard-to-solve problems and create scalable solutions throughout the company to enable its hyper-growth. From optimizing product workflows to ensuring seamless operations, there's nothing our Product Operations team can't do. Our Product Operations team isn't here to maintain existing systems but to drive the development and management of world-class products from inception to delivery. Your responsibilities will include:
  
  

* Assist the Product Operations team in designing and implementing scalable processes to support our products and drive Trade Republic's growth.
* Coordinate customer communication across multiple stakeholders.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product/Engineering, Operations, Legal/Compliance.
* Dig deep and solve our toughest problems to continue Trade Republic's success
* Think big and continuously deliver impactful results for our employees and customers

**What We're Looking For**

* Fluency in German and English is essential
* Currently enrolled in a university (study focus in the field of computer science, physics or other relevant fields)
* Initial relevant experience in a fast-paced environment (high growth startup, leading management consulting firm or investment bank)
* Proficiency in SQL and a strong analytical mindset.
* Interest in banking, finance, capital markets, and their regulatory frameworks
* Exceptional communication skills, a highly organised work ethic, and a self-driven, dedicated attitude.

**WHY YOU SHOULD APPLY NOW**
Our culture rewards ownership, excellence, and high energy. We care deeply about outcomes and hold each other accountable - we're here to win and fix one of the largest challenges Europeans face - closing the pension gap and democratising wealth. If this gets you fired up, reach out!
  
  
We believe it's our team's varied identities and backgrounds that make us sharper and stronger. We're committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected and has equal opportunity to thrive in their careers. For any questions on DEI during the interview process, reach out to your recruitment partner.

title: Working Student – Applied AI (all genders)
description:
**Locations**
: München | Düsseldorf | Berlin
  
  
Who We Are
  
  
Our strategy? To be anything but typical strategy consultants! Our unconventional nature is embedded deep in our DNA. Over 60 years ago, BCG shook up the world of strategy consulting. Now, it has grown to become one of the world leaders in the field. How do we manage to stay ahead of the pack? The answer is simple: by reinventing ourselves every day and providing a home with diverse career opportunities to the best talent and most creative minds all over the world. And by giving you the chance to make an impact in business and society. BCG stands for authenticity, exceptional work, and strong integrity. Once you’ve become part of the Group, we’ll help you find your path, unleash your potential, effect change, and advance the world.
  
  
#jointhegroup
  
  
Our most vital resource is our people. That’s why Human Resources is one of our most important teams: From recruiting to career development for BCGers, from training and mobility support to staffing (assigning our consultants to client casework), the Human Resources Team plays a decisive role in making BCG not just a company, but a Group in which every employee can become their best.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As a
**Working Student**
in the CE Applied AI Team, you will support the hands-on deployment of AI tools into real case team workflows, helping to translate concrete business needs into practical, lightweight AI-enabled solutions that improve day-to-day project work.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include**

* Supporting AI tool deployment You will help configure and adapt AI tools for selected case teams, including setting up custom GPTs, assisting with prompt optimization, and supporting simple API-based integrations.
* Building and testing prototypes You will develop small prototypes and automations to test new use cases, iterate them based on feedback, and refine solutions into usable setups.
* Assisting with agent and workflow design You will contribute to the design and optimization of AI-supported workflows, including basic prompt engineering and structured experimentation with different tools.
* Providing operational support You will support consultants with technical questions, troubleshooting, and onboarding to AI-enabled workflows, ensuring smooth integration into project work.
* Exploring new GenAI capabilities You will test new AI features and tools and help assess their relevance for internal and case-related use cases.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* You are currently enrolled in a full-time bachelor’s or master’s program in computer science, data science, business informatics, or a related field.
* You have some experience with AI tools and workflows, ideally including API integrations and prompt engineering; experience with tools such as Claude, Cursor, or n8n is a plus.
* You have programming knowledge (Python, JavaScript, or similar)
* You have strong analytical skills and a keen interest in AI-driven process automation.
* You are fluent in English and German.

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

* You build before you polish. You default to “let me try it” instead of “let me research it.” You move fast, iterate quickly, and prefer a rough prototype today over a perfect plan next week. You have likely hacked together scripts or lightweight tools to automate something simply because it was faster to build than to wait.
* You are hands-on with Python, APIs, and LLMs. You do not need to be a senior engineer, but you can write a working Python script, call an API, and prompt an LLM effectively. Experience with tools such as Claude, Cursor, or n8n is a plus. What matters most is that you learn new tools quickly and apply them pragmatically.
* You bridge technology and business. You do more than code. You translate messy, ambiguous business problems into structured, automatable workflows. You are comfortable speaking with nontechnical stakeholders, clarifying what they actually need rather than just what they ask for, and delivering solutions that create tangible value.
* You are self-directed and dependable. With limited hours available, you make every session count. You absorb context quickly, work independently between check-ins, and communicate proactively when you are blocked or when you have delivered. You require minimal guidance and manage your time responsibly.
* You are genuinely curious about GenAI and its real-world impact. You experiment with AI tools in your own time, whether building agents, automating personal workflows, or testing what is possible. You see AI as a lever for step-change impact, not incremental improvement.

Who You'll Work With
  
  
You will work autonomously while staying in close alignment with the Applied AI Team and other key stakeholders driving AI adoption at BCG. You will work under the direction of the CE Applied AI Lead, who will provide strategic guidance and ensure a smooth onboarding experience. In addition, you will provide operational support for case teams, assisting with AI-driven workflow optimizations, remote troubleshooting, and hands-on AI tool configuration to ensure seamless integration into day-to-day project work.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**WHAT WE OFFER YOU\***

* Free beverages, fresh fruit, snacks, and cereal are available every day.
* Stop by our coffee machines and treat yourself to your favorite hot drinks!
* Our terrace will invite you to relax with a great view of the city.
* Regular after-work events are organized for team building and fun—we’d love to have you join us!
* As a dynamic, internationally active company, the diverse work environment at BCG will inspire you.
* New ways of working? They’re nothing new to us. Our employees use hybrid models that combine on-site and remote work, supported by digital collaboration tools.
* Our in-house gym is well equipped and free for you to use any time.
* Great location: Right in the heart of the city, our office is close by and easy to reach.
* Benefits may vary by location.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Working Student – Compliance Automation & AI (m/f/d)
description:
**ABOUT US**

Pliant is a modular B2B payments platform that combines commercial card issuing, payment accounts, FX, and spend management in one system — adapting to existing setups rather than requiring customers to replace them.

Businesses across industries such as travel, e-commerce, and insurance use Pliant to manage complex payment workflows with cards, backed by credit lines Pliant underwrites itself.

Fintechs and software platforms embed Pliant's payment infrastructure into their own products, from API-based Cards-as-a-Service to fully white-label solutions. Banks use Pliant's Card & Spend OS, the customer-facing interface, on their own infrastructure to run card programs.

Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Berlin, Pliant serves 5,000+ businesses and 40+ partners across Europe and the United States. A principal member of Visa and Mastercard, Pliant issues commercial cards in 13 currencies across 32 countries — under its own European e-money license and with licensed partners in the UK and US.

Learn more at www.getpliant.com

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for an exceptional working student to join our team — someone who wants to build expertise in fintech and banking, sharpen their analytical skills, and work alongside senior specialists on critical operational risk topics.

As a **Working Student – Compliance Automation & AI (m/f/d)**, you’ll sit at the intersection of fintech, data, and operational risk management. You’ll work on high-impact tasks in client onboarding, risk profiling, and transaction surveillance — while leveraging data-driven applications, Python, and AI tools to enhance efficiency and insight.

You’ll collaborate closely with our Compliance, Risk, Product, and Engineering teams, gaining hands-on experience in one of Europe’s fastest-scaling fintechs.

This role is **Berlin-based** with the ability to work at least **2 days per week from our Berlin HQ.**

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

**Onboarding, Risk & Transaction Surveillance**

* Verify corporate clients (KYB), identifying legal representatives and beneficial owners through global databases and registries.
* Assess customer risk profiles using structured data, defined frameworks, and regulatory guidelines.
* Review AML alerts from monitoring systems, flag anomalies, and escalate potential cases to senior specialists.
* Analyze transaction patterns to detect suspicious behaviors or potential financial crime indicators.
* Prepare and maintain accurate digital credit files in compliance with internal policies.
* Contribute to the refinement of detection rules to reduce false positives and improve monitoring effectiveness.

**Data & Technology Integration**

title: GTM Engineering Working Student
description:
Companies have invested billions into ERP systems. And yet, most business decisions are still made the way they were in 1995: on fragmented data, manual exports, and Excel. Finance teams spend five to ten days every month copy-pasting numbers, and four systems show four versions of the same revenue.

  

AI changes that. At ARC, we are building the AI-native Finance OS: one platform that connects all of a company's systems, answers any question in seconds, finds errors before they cost millions, and automates reporting end to end. Leading Mittelstand companies like Burmester, Pfanner, and Ferrotec, and PE firms like AUCTUS and GENUI, already run their finance on ARC. Finance software is being rebuilt from the ground up this decade, and we intend to win the category.

  

We are a small, AI-native team in Berlin, fresh off our seed round led by 42CAP, growing revenue 10x since our pre-seed. We build, experiment, and move fast, take real ownership, and keep a low-ego culture.

  

**Aufgaben**

  

You are the GTM Engineering Intern at ARC. While our BDRs are on the phone with CFOs, you build the machine behind them: the automations, data pipelines, and AI workflows that decide who we call, with what message, and when. We sell an AI-native platform, so our own go-to-market has to run AI-native too. You'll build our internal GTM OS from the ground up.

  

**What you'll do**

  

  
* Build automated prospecting pipelines: sourcing multi-entity Mittelstand groups and PE-backed companies that fit our ICP, at scale
  
* Enrich accounts and contacts with the signals that matter to us: legal entities, ERP landscape, PE ownership, trigger events like ERP migrations or acquisitions
  
* Automate outreach workflows across email, LinkedIn, and phone, and keep them personal enough that a German CFO actually responds
  
* Connect and orchestrate our GTM stack (HubSpot, Aircall, enrichment and outreach tools) into one system with clean data flowing through it
  
* Use AI models aggressively: for research, list building, message drafting, call analysis, and anything else that removes manual work from the pipeline
  
* Build dashboards and KPI tracking so we always know what's working in outbound and what isn't
  
* Prototype, test, and iterate: your experiments directly shape how ARC's GTM engine works as we scale the sales team
  

  

**Qualifikation**

  

**What makes you a great fit**

  

  
* You love building things: with no-code tools, scripts, APIs, or AI agents, whatever gets it done fastest
  
* You're deep in the modern AI tool stack and use LLMs daily as a matter of course
  
* You're analytical and rigorous with data: messy lists and broken syncs bother you until they're fixed
  
* You have strong business sense and can think from the prospect's perspective, not just the pipeline's
  
* You're hands-on and not afraid of unglamorous work: cleaning a CRM included
  
* You communicate well in English; German is a plus since our market is the German Mittelstand
  
* You want to work with smart and friendly people with (self-reported) low ego
  
* You want to work on-site 5 days a week in our new Berlin office
  

  

**You may not be a good fit if**

  

  
* You need detailed instructions and shy away from taking responsibility
  
* You're not willing to deeply understand the product and the buyer behind your automations
  
* You're only interested in high-level "strategic" work
  
* You think GTM engineering means setting up one Zapier flow
  
* You've never built anything on your own initiative
  
* You prefer working remotely
  
* You prefer working with minimal collaboration
  
* You want to work a 9-5 job

title: Working Student Operations
description:
**About lemon.markets**

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

**Your Mission:**

As our Operations Working Student, you will support the day-to-day processes that keep our investing products and customer operations running smoothly. Your work will include instrument management, trading monitoring, regulatory and operational tasks, as well as customer onboarding, account changes, and partner requests. You will work with experienced colleagues, learn how the securities lifecycle and customer operations work in practice, and take ownership of clearly scoped tasks as you grow into the role.

You’ll collaborate with colleagues across Securities Operations, Market Operations, Customer Operations, Product, Engineering, and Compliance to help create a reliable end-to-end experience for partners and customers. Expect hands-on learning, varied tasks, and the opportunity to improve how we work, without being expected to arrive as a securities or regulatory expert.

You will support our daily Investing and Customer Operations, help investigate issues, and contribute to making our processes more reliable and efficient.

  

**In this role you will support with:**

* **Trading Monitoring:** Support daily checks of trading activity and operational workflows. Spot unusual activity, failed or rejceted orders, and data discrepancies; help investigate them and escalate findings.
* **Regulatory Checks & Controls:** Help prepare data, maintain documentation and evidence, and track recurring regulatory and compliance-related tasks. Work closely with the responsible specialists to make sure follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
* **Cross-Functional Topics:** Support projects and day-to-day questions involving Investing Operations, Product, Engineering, Compliance, and other Operations teams - for example, by testing process changes, gathering information, or coordinating open items.
* **Process Improvement & Quality Assurance:** Identify opportunities to improve day-to-day workflows, help turn ideas into practical process changes, and keep operational documentation up to date.
* **Partner Support & Customer Operations:** Help process partner requests relating to their customers, including account requests and customer-data changes, and route more complex cases to the right colleagues.
* **KYC Operations & Quality Assurance:** Support identity-verification workflows, record checks accurately, and help review operational work so our customer processes remain dependable and compliant.

**You will be successful in this role if:**

* You are currently enrolled at a German university in business administration, economics, operations, or a similar degree program, and will remain enrolled for at least one more year.
* You are curious about investing, financial markets, and how brokerage works. Some familiarity with financial products / operational processes or some first work experience in this area is a plus.
* You work carefully and in a structured way: you pay attention to details, keep track of open items, and understand why accuracy matters in a regulated environment.
* You are reliable and take ownership of your tasks. You follow through, ask questions when something is unclear, and flag issues early rather than making assumptions.
* You bring a learning and growth mindset. You enjoy getting to know new tools and processes, welcome feedback, and are comfortable adapting when priorities change.
* You have a hands-on, collaborative approach and enjoy working with people across different teams to find practical solutions.
* You are based in Berlin and available to work in a hybrid setup with regular time in the office.

**How we take care of you:**

* **Compensation package:** Our working student positions are compensated at a fixed rate of €15-17 per hour.
* **Make a real impact:** Our start-up environment gives you the room to start your career, explore areas outside your role, and build expertise through ownership. As we mature and are backed by dwpbank, we’re adding a layer of resources and expertise you are benefiting from.
* **Flexible working hours:** We know your studies come first. That’s why we offer flexible hours that adapt to your class schedule and exam periods, so you can plan your work time around your semester.
* **Hybrid work setup:** You can work from Berlin within a hybrid model. That being said, we encourage our working student lemoneers to come to the office regularly. Being on-site allows you to learn faster, provides a more immersive experience, helps you collaborate more effectively with the team, and ensures you fully benefit from hands-on support.
* **Grow with us:** We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, plus a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations so you always know where you stand, and what to do to level up.
* **People & culture:** You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate.
* **Workation:** Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply.

If you feel this role could be a great match for you even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you, please apply.

You have any questions? Feel free to contact us via talent@lemon.markets

title: Working Student - Product & Project Management (all genders)
description:
Support us in designing the insurance experience of the future. As a Working Student in Product & Project Management for most of your time, you run projects with our partners and internal teams from first request to done. When there's time, you work on data projects. You work closely with the Head of Product and see up close how product decisions get made.
  
  
This is a 20h/week hybrid role, with 1 day per week working from our Berlin office.

  
  
**Requirements**  

### **Your Mission**

* Check and triage new requests from partners and internal teams on our Jira board: what is it, how urgent is it, and who owns it?

* Clarify requirements with stakeholders and turn them into clear tickets for our product squads
* Find the right people (Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, Legal) and bring them together
* Answer questions yourself where you can; check reported bugs yourself and test fixes before they go live
* Track every project until it's closed, and send a short regular status update to stakeholders
* Help us organise how feature requests from internal teams are collected, tracked and made visible to the product managers
* Prepare priority calls and escalations for the Head of Product
* Build and maintain dashboards for our product KPIs
* Run analyses for the product team, e.g. how a KPI changed before and after a release
* Tools you will work with: Jira, Confluence, Slack, Google Workspace, Metabase / SQL

### **What You Will Need to Succeed**

* Enrolled at a university (working student status), available 20 h/week for at least 12 months

* German at B2 level or higher, plus good English. Many of our partners and stakeholders work in German.
* Strong analytical thinking and a record of excellent results (grades, scholarships, projects, competitions)
* Technical affinity: you understand how web apps, APIs and data flows work, or you learn fast. An error message or a data table doesn't scare you.
* Structured and reliable: you keep many threads open without dropping one, and you follow up without being asked
* Clear writing, and confidence with experienced stakeholders

### **What Would Make You Stand Out**

* First experience in product management, consulting, a startup or project coordination
* SQL skills
* Experience building with AI or automation tools (n8n, Zapier, LLM APIs)
Interest in insurance, health or insurtech  

  
  
**Benefits**

**Why getolo?**

**Vacation**

* Start with 28 vacation days, with an increase every two years (capped at 30 days). Holidays on December 24th and 31st. Vacation entitlement for working students is prorated based on working days per week

‍ **Mobility & Flexibility**

* Work hybrid - from your home office or in our office in Berlin-Mitte

**Health**

* Benefit from free coaching sessions with nilo.health, our mental health tool
* Test our products yourself! Choose between dentolo, petolo or vitolo

**Development**

* Regular (360 degree) feedback

**Berlin Based, International Mindset**

* We communicate, collaborate, and celebrate in English to ensure everyone is included
* Our diverse team spans from 33 different countries

**Values**

* Our values are not buzzwords, but actions that are a part of our individual and collective DNA:
* + #fast: We simplify, move with urgency, and focus on outcomes
  + #brave: We take bold decisions, challenge the status quo, and act with conviction
  + #accountable: We deliver end-to-end, reduce dependencies, and own our decisions
  + #caring: We treat each other with respect, build trust, and create an environment where everyone can thrive

**And much more…**

* Legendary summer and winter parties
* Regular team events
* Many discounts on the corporate Benefits Platform
* Two Community Days per calendar year
* Pet friendly office

Sounds like the perfect job for you? We look forward to receiving your application and getting to know you!

**About getolo**

Founded in 2015, getolo GmbH is an innovative and award-winning InsurTech company that offers comprehensive supplementary insurance plans in the areas of dental, pet health and liability, as well as health add-on coverage. Under the brands dentolo, petolo, patolo and vitolo, we serve over 265,000 customers across Germany, France and Spain, providing digital and hassle-free protection that seamlessly integrates into their daily lives.  
We believe that prevention is always better than cure—which is why we focus on preventive care, customer-centric service, and financial security to protect our customers and their loved ones from unexpected costs. Thanks to the close collaboration of our team of market specialists and insurance experts, we continuously monitor industry developments to offer practical solutions for current challenges.  
getolo's company culture is built on collaboration, innovation, and agility—always with a strong focus on the needs of our customers. With a team of around 300 employees, getolo is led by Daniel Gadea (CEO) and Laura Wulff (CGO). getolo is a partner of DA Direkt and part of the Zurich Group Germany.

getolo is an equal opportunity and diversity employer. We strive to create a friendly, safe, and welcoming environment for all our team members, regardless of ethnicity, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, limitations and talents of any kind, physical appearance, social background, marital status, age, or religion (or lack thereof).

When you apply, we focus solely on your experience and motivation. You decide what additional information you want to disclose (photo, marital status, religion, gender, nationality, etc.). We value and treat all applications equally.

getolo Recruiting Team

title: ­Working Student Digital Product Management (all genders) – Beats & Bytes – Universal Music Entertainment GmbH
description:
Universal Music is the market leader in the music business. The world’s most famous and most successful record labels belong to us. We’ve been writing music history for over 100 years representing legendary musicians across all genres. Our accomplishments are driven by our love for music, extraordinary artists and our ambitious team.
  
  
Beats & Bytes (B3S) is our tech organization and is comprised of a network of product teams. To be agile and innovative, we live and foster psychological safety, constructive nonconformity and diversity of thought! Empowerment and community are part of our culture. As the technical backbone we generate added value for Universal Music by solving our users’ problems. The B3S Team forms the digital foundation for our business and actively contributes to the competitive advantage of Universal Music.
  
  
Here’s your chance to join!
**Effective**
**as of now**
, we’re looking for a
**working student (all genders) Digital Product Management**
to join us within our
**Beats and Bytes**
department in the eCommerce team at our headquarters in Berlin.
  
  
**This Is What You Can Learn Here**

* You can grow into the field of product management
* You learn about user-centric product management
* You will learn how quality assurance and testing fit into the product lifecycle - from feature development to delivery and user acceptance testing (UAT)
* You will develop communication and documentation skills to ensure clear alignment between technical and non-technical teams
* You will gain experience in identifying, reproducing, and documenting issues, and understand how Quality Assurance contributes to continuous improvement in digital products
* You will gain exposure to sales, supply chain, and finance processes in eCommerce and learn how the systems supporting these processes connect and interact.
* You will learn the B3S way – working in a creative and supportive cross-functional team that connects product, engineering, and business operations

**What You Will Be Doing**

* You will work closely with the Product Managers of the eCommerce Team
* You will be responsible for some of the product management tasks like writing user stories
* You will work in product trios with product management, design, research, insights and engineering
* You provide first-level product support for internal teams and help resolve issues in collaboration with engineering
* Assist in user acceptance testing (UAT) and coordinate feedback loops with stakeholders
* Document testing outcomes, feature behavior, and user feedback for product improvements will also be in your field of work
* You maintain and improve our product documentation and support guides
* What else would you like to learn? Let’s discuss your interests – a lot is possible with our team!

**We Would Like To Meet You If**

* You are enrolled in a full-time degree programme in product management or another relevant field, with more than 12 months remaining in your studies.
* You think strategically and unconventionally, quickly connecting disparate information to uncover insights opportunities and actionable outcomes
* You have an interest in product development, testing, and technical support
* You are detail-oriented, organized, and enjoy solving problems
* You are proficient in English (German skills are a plus)
* You have a proactive, team-oriented mindset and are eager to learn
* Basic knowledge of eCommerce systems
* You are excited to work in a fast-paced environment and collaborate across teams

**Our Values, Our Compass, Our Culture**

* Creativity – Home to Artists, Innovators and Entrepreneurs.
* Connection – We are ONE team.
* Passion – Music is our first love.
* Responsibility – It’s up to us.
* Diversity – Music is universal.
* Factuition – Guided by head AND heart.

**#joinuniversalmusic**
We look forward to receiving your application via our online application form! Please upload your documents (letter of motivation / cover letter, CV, references) as files and state your earliest starting date.
  
  
**MUSIC IS UNIVERSAL!**
As a large and globally operating company, Universal Music promotes diversity and opposes discrimination. We aspire to reflect the diversity represented by our artists through their music and individuality in our teams. We pledge ourselves to be an equal opportunity employer and enable individuals to express themselves – regardless of age, sex, gender, appearance, origin, faith, physical/mental ability, or sexual orientation.
  
  
If you are unsure about submitting an application because, for example, you do not fulfil all of the requirements, we would like to encourage you to try it nonetheless!
  
  
**#YOUatUMG**

title: Working Student (m/f/d) - Project Management Asset Services
description:
**Hybrid | Part time | Student (not yet graduated)**
Trench Group is a global technology leader for high-voltage grid components and systems, present in nearly every power transmission grid worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, with more than 100 years of engineering expertise, Trench Group designs and manufactures high-voltage components that address the core challenges of modern power infrastructure – connecting grids, measuring their performance and ensuring reliability. As electricity demand rises and power grids transform worldwide, Trench Group is a key enabler of the infrastructure the world needs. The company operates 11 factories across 8 countries on 4 continents and employs more than 3,000 people – with plans to grow to 4,000 by 2030.
  
  
**Your Misson**
As a Working Student in Asset Services, you will support global product development, customer support process optimization, project coordination, and AI-driven reporting initiatives. You will collaborate with international teams across Sales, After Sales, IT, business units, external vendors, and manufacturing sites to develop effective service solutions and improve operational efficiency.
  
  
**Your Tasks:**

* Product Support: Support for Asset Services on installed base and Reporting at a global level across factories.
* Processes: Work with EMEA and Americas teams to develop, improve, and streamline customer support processes.
* Partnerships: Support the development of partnerships with external vendors and assist in creating required offers and documentation.
* Project Management: Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders on project activities, track progress, follow up on action items, and support reporting.
* Technical Development: Support the development of AI-based tools for internal reporting and business applications.

We are looking for a **Working Student - Product Operations (m/f/d)** to support the daily operations of the Appinio mobile app and help ensure a smooth, high-quality user experience.

* **Documentation & Collaboration:** Document findings clearly and maintain internal tracking of bugs, incidents, and quality issues. Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Development and Quality Assurance.

**You will thrive in this role if**

* You are currently enrolled at a university and have **at least 1 year of studies remaining.**

* You are organized, detail-oriented, and able to work through tasks in a structured way. You are comfortable handling operational tasks, recurring processes, and repetitive work while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
* You have strong communication skills and can clearly describe issues and observations.
* You are proactive, reliable, and have a high sense of ownership. You can identify what is important and urgent and are comfortable making judgment calls within clear guidelines.

title: Working Student Digital Product Management (all genders) – Beats & Bytes – Universal Music Entertainment GmbH
description:
Universal Music is the market leader in the music business. The world’s most famous and most successful record labels belong to us. We’ve been writing music history for over 100 years representing legendary musicians across all genres. Our accomplishments are driven by our love for music, extraordinary artists and our ambitious team.

Beats & Bytes (B3S) is our tech organization and is comprised of a network of product teams. To be agile and innovative, we live and foster psychological safety, constructive nonconformity and diversity of thought! Empowerment and community are part of our culture. As the technical backbone we generate added value for Universal Music by solving our users’ problems. The B3S Team forms the digital foundation for our business and actively contributes to the competitive advantage of Universal Music.

Here’s your chance to join! **Effective** **as of now**, we’re looking for a **working student (all genders) Digital Product Management** to join us within our **Beats and Bytes** department in the eCommerce team at our headquarters in Berlin.

**This is what you can learn here:**

* You can grow into the field of product management
* You learn about user-centric product management
* You will learn how quality assurance and testing fit into the product lifecycle - from feature development to delivery and user acceptance testing (UAT)
* You will develop communication and documentation skills to ensure clear alignment between technical and non-technical teams
* You will gain experience in identifying, reproducing, and documenting issues, and understand how Quality Assurance contributes to continuous improvement in digital products
* You will gain exposure to sales, supply chain, and finance processes in eCommerce and learn how the systems supporting these processes connect and interact.
* You will learn the B3S way – working in a creative and supportive cross-functional team that connects product, engineering, and business operations

**What you will be doing:**

* You will work closely with the Product Managers of the eCommerce Team
* You will be responsible for some of the product management tasks like writing user stories
* You will work in product trios with product management, design, research, insights and engineering
* You provide first-level product support for internal teams and help resolve issues in collaboration with engineering
* Assist in user acceptance testing (UAT) and coordinate feedback loops with stakeholders
* Document testing outcomes, feature behavior, and user feedback for product improvements will also be in your field of work
* You maintain and improve our product documentation and support guides
What else would you like to learn? Let’s discuss your interests – a lot is possible with our team!  

**We would like to meet you if:**

* You are enrolled in a full-time degree programme in product management or another relevant field, with more than 12 months remaining in your studies.
* You think strategically and unconventionally, quickly connecting disparate information to uncover insights opportunities and actionable outcomes
* You have an interest in product development, testing, and technical support
* You are detail-oriented, organized, and enjoy solving problems
* You are proficient in English (German skills are a plus)
* You have a proactive, team-oriented mindset and are eager to learn
* Basic knowledge of eCommerce systems
* You are excited to work in a fast-paced environment and collaborate across teams

**Our values, our compass, our culture:**

* Creativity – Home to Artists, Innovators and Entrepreneurs.
* Connection – We are ONE team.
* Passion – Music is our first love.
* Responsibility – It’s up to us.
* Diversity – Music is universal.
* Factuition – Guided by head AND heart.

**#joinuniversalmusic**  
We look forward to receiving your application via our online application form! Please upload your documents (letter of motivation / cover letter, CV, references) as files and state your earliest starting date.

**MUSIC IS UNIVERSAL!**  
As a large and globally operating company, Universal Music promotes diversity and opposes discrimination. We aspire to reflect the diversity represented by our artists through their music and individuality in our teams. We pledge ourselves to be an equal opportunity employer and enable individuals to express themselves – regardless of age, sex, gender, appearance, origin, faith, physical/mental ability, or sexual orientation.

If you are unsure about submitting an application because, for example, you do not fulfil all of the requirements, we would like to encourage you to try it nonetheless!

**Job Description**
For Grid Solutions, Offshore HVDC represents a key differentiating technology and a central focus for the business, particularly in Europe where Transmission System Operators have ambitious renewable energy targets. We are looking for a Working Student to support the Spare Parts and Customer Training workstreams for a portfolio of mega HVDC projects based in Berlin, Germany.
  
  

* Your Responsibilities:

+ Project Operations: Support the Project Management team in executing operational milestones and tracking project progress.
+ RAMS & Technical Alignment: Coordinate with internal RAMS and engineering teams to ensure project documentation is accurate and technically aligned with specifications.
+ Spare Parts Strategy: Support the "wing-to-wing" management of the spare parts strategy, including compiling documentation, maintaining the Spare Parts List (SPL), and tracking procurement statuses.
+ Training Management: Support the development of the Training Management Plan and take ownership of maintaining the Training Matrix to ensure all customer contractual requirements are met.
+ Documentation & Reporting: Supplement and revise project presentations and technical documents; maintain and analyze complex data in MS Excel, Smartsheet, SAP, and MS Project.
+ Stakeholder Engagement: Participate in meetings with customers and internal departments, ensuring clear communication and timely follow-up on action items.

* Your Profile:

+ Education: Currently pursuing a degree in Electrical Engineering, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable field.
+ Technical Proficiency: A "Digital native" proficient in MS Office. Advanced MS Excel skills (including PivotTables) are essential. Experience with Smartsheet, Power BI, or SAP is a significant advantage.
+ Working Style: Independent, reliable, and structured, with a hands-on mentality and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
+ Collaboration: A natural team player who thrives in virtual, international environments.
+ Communication: Strong communication skills with a customer-oriented mindset.
+ Languages: English is mandatory; German language skills are a significant advantage.

* We Offer:

+ Smooth Onboarding: Welcome days to ensure a successful start.
+ Flexibility: Flexible working hours and the possibility to work remotely.
+ Mentorship: Work directly alongside experienced Project Managers and technical specialists.
+ Career Growth: Exposure to the full lifecycle of major offshore wind grid connection projects.
+ Culture: Experience a fast-paced environment with access to the Berlin site’s company cafeteria and other corporate benefits.

No

title: Working Student Revenue Operations and GTM Strategy
description:
**The role and the team**
As a Working Student Revenue Operations and GTM Strategy (all genders), you help build Lucanet's scalable revenue engine: keeping GTM data clean, building AI-powered workflows with Clay and Claude, and documenting the processes behind our B2B SaaS revenue. You work hands-on with Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, and Chili Piper from day one and see how a modern RevOps function is run.
  
  
You report into the Revenue Operations & GTM Strategy team within Revenue Architecture & Operations and work closely with RevOps, Deal Desk, and GTM leadership across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Excellence. Your work feeds directly into reporting, process design, and strategic projects such as territory design and our Bowtie operating model, and you work remotely from Germany. We look for people who keep growing, take real ownership, and lift the people around them.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Support data collection, cleansing, and enrichment across our revenue technology stack, including Salesforce and HubSpot.
* Build and test AI-powered GTM workflows with Clay, Claude, Gong, and other automation tools.
* Prepare recurring reports, dashboards, and ad hoc analyses for GTM leadership.

title: Working Student – Offshore O&M Asset Management
description:
**Company:** Iberdrola Renovables Deutschland GmbH
  
**Location:** Berlin, Germany
  
**Working pattern:** Office-based
  
**Department:** Asset Management

  
  

**MISSION**

  

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Working Student to join our Offshore O&M Asset Management team in Berlin. In this role, you will support a range of operational and commercial activities, with a particular focus on data analysis, reporting, cost tracking, and continuous process improvement.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES AND FUNCTIONS**

  

The Working Student will support the Offshore O&M Asset Management team in:

  
  

* Support the collection, validation, and reporting of production and metering data for offshore wind assets.
* Support SAP-related activities, including purchase order tracking, invoice follow-up, approval workflows, and payment monitoring.
* Assist with budget preparation, forecasting activities, and cost tracking.
* Assist in the preparation of reports, presentations, procedures, and internal documentation.
* Contribute to the review and improvement of operational and commercial processes, including invoicing, metering, and revenue reporting.
* Perform data analysis, reconciliation, and quality checks across multiple information sources.
* Support special projects related to offshore wind operations, energy markets, business reporting, and process automation.
  

**PROFILE AND REQUIREMENTS**

  

* Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Economics, Business Administration, Energy Management, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
* Proactive attitude and willingness to learn.
* Fluent English.
Availability to work from the Berlin office in accordance with the agreed working schedule.  

  

**DESIRABLE SKILLS**

  

* Knowledge of SAP.
* Experience with Power BI, Power Query, VBA, Python, or automation tools.
* Interest in renewable energy and offshore wind.
* French, Spanish, or German language skills.
  

**PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES**

  

* Proactive and self-driven.
* Curious and eager to learn.
* Comfortable working with data and analytical tasks.
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Ability to identify opportunities for improvement and support their implementation.
Team player with good communication skills.  

  

**WHAT WE OFFER**

  

* Join a global leader in renewable energy and play an active role in driving the energy transition.
* Gain valuable hands-on experience in an international and dynamic work environment.
* Attractive compensation for working students in line with market standards.
* Modern office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte with excellent public transport connections.
* Exclusive employee discounts with numerous partner companies across retail, travel, technology, and other industries.
  

  

**Mobility Information**

Please note that any applicant who is not a citizen of the country of the vacancy will be subject to compliance with the applicable immigration requirements to legally work in that country.

  
  

**Job Posting End Date:**

  
November-30-2026

* Immatrikulation an einer deutschen Hochschule oder Universität.

Our teams work from
**Grasblau**
in Berlin, a modern and sustainable office with plenty of natural light, quiet rooms and spaces designed for collaboration and focused work.

title: Working Student (m/f/d) Research & Development in Secure and Trustworthy AI
description:
**Working Student (m/f/d) Research & Development in Secure and Trustworthy AI**
===============================================================================

Join secunet’s research and technology innovation team at the earliest opportunity. Within our core technology field of Secure and Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence, you will help explore how to build secure and trustworthy AI infrastructures and services—and demonstrate that they meet defined security and reliability requirements. Our focus is on large language models (LLMs) and AI agents.

**Your Tasks**
--------------

You will contribute to research and development projects, explore new ideas and learn from experienced colleagues. Depending on your interests and experience, your responsibilities will include:

* Investigating security and assurance methods for LLMs and AI agents, including guardrails, runtime verification, sandboxing, prompt injection mitigation, formal methods and agent identities
* Evaluating emerging technologies and developing approaches to assess and substantiate their security and reliability
* Building prototypes to assess feasibility and test assumptions
* Contributing to research projects with academic and technology partners
* Helping transfer promising research results into our product and service units
* Documenting findings and contributing to security guidelines and reference architectures

You will work with NixOS as our Linux operating system, Rust for the components we develop, Nix for declarative builds and dependency management, and GitLab as our development platform.

**Your Profile**
----------------

* You are currently enrolled in a master’s programme in computer science or a related field
* You have practical programming experience and are keen to learn our technology stack
* You are interested in research at the intersection of AI, systems security and assurance
* You enjoy exploring emerging technologies and approaching new challenges with curiosity
* You work independently and systematically and enjoy collaborating with others
* You are proficient in English; German language skills are a plus
* Ideally, you have hands-on experience with LLM systems, Rust, Linux, Nix or Kubernetes
* An understanding of IT security, software verification or systematic testing would be an advantage

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Team spirit:** Work with colleagues who support each other and tackle challenging projects together.
* **Meaningful work:** Contribute to IT security solutions that make a difference.
* **Individual development:** Develop your skills with support tailored to your interests and goals.
* **People first:** Join a workplace that values diversity, mutual respect and a healthy balance between work and personal life.
* **Flexible working:** Organise your working hours around your studies, with up to 20 hours per week.
* **Work from abroad:** Work remotely from another EU country for up to 20 days per year.
* **Additional benefits:** Enjoy corporate fitness, a discounted public transport ticket, secudog and more.
* **Attractive remuneration:** Your hourly rate reflects your qualifications, progress in your studies and relevant practical experience.

**Your Contact**
----------------

secunet Security Networks AG  
Beatrice Mungen  
Kurfürstenstraße 58  
45138 Essen  
  
Would you like to help shape the future of secure and trustworthy AI in an environment built on trust and fairness? We look forward to receiving your complete application, quoting reference **3540/A.**

title: Werkstudent:in Sales Operations – KI, Automatisierung & Daten (d/m/w)
description:
Tagesspiegel Impact vermarktet die Werbelösungen des Tagesspiegels in Print und Digital. Damit sich unsere Verkaufsteams auf ihre Kund:innen konzentrieren können, sorgt das Team Sales Operations für verlässliche Daten, gute Prozesse und Tools, die Arbeit abnehmen. Genau hier steigst Du ein.
  
  
Bei uns bekommst Du keine Daueraufgabe. Du übernimmst eigene kleine Projekte, die echte Probleme im Arbeitsalltag lösen. Drei Beispiele, wie das aussehen kann:
  
  

* Formular statt Mail-Pingpong: Anfragen an ein Team laufen bisher per Mail und gehen unter. Du klärst mit den Kolleginnen und Kollegen, welche Angaben sie brauchen. Dann baust Du ein Formular in Jotform und sorgst dafür, dass jede Anfrage automatisch bei den richtigen Ansprechpartner:innen landet.
* Erste Automatisierung mit KI: Du testest in Langdock (unsere KI-Plattform, über die wir Sprachmodelle wie GPT oder Claude nutzen), wie sich eine wiederkehrende Aufgabe automatisieren lässt, etwa das Zusammenfassen von Kund:inneninformationen. Daraus baust Du einen ersten Prototyp.
* Analyse für eine Entscheidung: Du führst Daten aus mehreren Quellen in Excel zusammen und bereitest sie so auf, dass eine konkrete Frage klar beantwortet werden kann.

**Das sind Deine Aufgaben:**

* Du setzt eigene kleine Projekte um: Bedarf verstehen, Lösung bauen, testen, übergeben
* Du baust Formulare und einfache Abläufe in Jotform
* Du probierst KI-Anwendungen in Langdock aus und entwickelst erste Automatisierungen
* Du bereitest Daten in Excel auf und verknüpfst Tabellen, z. B. mit XVERWEIS
* Du arbeitest Dich in neue Tools ein, sobald wir sie brauchen
* Du dokumentierst Deine Lösungen so, dass andere damit weiterarbeiten können

**Das bringst Du mit:**

* Du bist eingeschrieben, idealerweise in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder einem ähnlichen Fach. Du studierst etwas ganz anderes? Bewirb Dich trotzdem. Bei uns haben schon Leute aus sehr unterschiedlichen Studiengängen richtig gut gepasst
* Du tüftelst gern und legst auch ohne fertige Anleitung los
* Ein neues Tool ist für Dich eine Einladung, kein Hindernis
* Du kannst sicher mit Excel umgehen und Tabellen verknüpfen
* Erste Erfahrung mit KI-Tools, No-Code-Tools oder Automatisierung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss
* Du sprichst sicher Deutsch, denn Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Verkaufsteams zusammen

**Das bieten wir Dir:**

* Verantwortung für eigene Projekte statt reiner Zuarbeit
* Einblicke in Vermarktung, CRM, Daten und den Einsatz von KI in einem Medienhaus
* Kontinuierliches, ehrliches Feedback, damit Du schnell wächst
* Ein klares Gefühl dafür, welche Arbeit dir liegt – eine gute Grundlage für die Zeit nach dem Studium
* Kreativer Freiraum in einem Team, in dem Ideen geschätzt werden und Du Deine Visionen in einem innovativen Medienunternehmen im Herzen Berlins umsetzen kannst
* Flache Hierarchien mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und direkter Kommunikation
* Bezuschusstes BVG-Firmenticket und Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge
* Kostenloses Digital-Abonnement von Tagesspiegel & Tagesspiegel Plus, Handelsblatt und die Zeit
* Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen Weiterentwicklung durch die Online-Plattform Masterplan, um Deine Karriere voranzutreiben
* 30 Urlaubstage (bei einer Vollzeitstelle), damit Du ausreichend Zeit hast, um Dich zu erholen
* Flexible Arbeitszeiten und mobiles Arbeiten bis zu 50%

Jede Nachricht erzählt eine eigene Geschichte – und so ist es auch mit den Menschen, die bei uns arbeiten. Beim Tagesspiegel schätzen wir die Vielfalt unserer Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter und sind fest davon überzeugt, dass unterschiedliche Perspektiven unsere Arbeit bereichern.
  
  
Wir setzen uns für Chancengleichheit ein und fördern einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, Religion, Alter oder sexueller Identität – bei uns bist Du willkommen. Lass uns gemeinsam ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld schaffen, in dem jeder seine Einzigartigkeit einbringen kann!
  
  
**Du denkst, wir sollten uns kennenlernen?**
Wenn Du bereit bist, Deine Fähigkeiten in einem inspirierenden Team einzusetzen und einen echten Unterschied zu machen, dann bewirb Dich jetzt über unser Bewerbungsportal
**https://verlagsjobs.tagesspiegel.de/**
und sende uns Deine Bewerbungsunterlagen. Gemeinsam erzählen wir Geschichten, die bewegen!
  
  
**Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen!**

title: Customer Support NL/ENG - Working Student
description:
**At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.**

**Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.**

As a Working Student in Customer Support, you will be the first point of contact for Dutch and English-speaking customers, helping them get the most out of Moss via live chat, email and phone. It is a hands-on role where you build real support experience in a fintech product.

You will report to the Team Lead Customer Support and work directly with the Berlin support team. What you learn from customers feeds back into how the team works, so your input shapes the support experience. The role comes with the potential for a permanent position.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Respond to customer inquiries in Dutch and English across live chat, email and phone, giving accurate answers quickly
* Own customer queries from first contact through to resolution
* Work directly with the Berlin support team to troubleshoot complex account issues
* Guide new corporate users through the web and mobile app, pointing them to self-service resources and documentation
* Share customer feedback with the team and contribute to improving internal support processes

**About you**
-------------

* Initial experience in customer support, client services, or another user-facing role
* Business-fluent English (C1/C2) and Dutch (native or C1+)
* Experience in fintech, SaaS or banking is a plus
* Interested in a long-term path at Moss

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

* Solves customer problems efficiently and with empathy
* Adapts tone to different customer personalities and stays calm in stressful conversations
* Picks up new software, CRM tools (such as Zendesk or Salesforce) and internal workflows quickly
* Writes and speaks clearly, in both Dutch and English
* Reliable and comfortable working as part of an onsite team

**About Moss**

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's **what else to expect:**

* Top-of-market compensation package, including equity.
* Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.
* Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

*Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).*

***By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our*** ***Data Privacy Policy******.***

title: People & Culture - Working Student (all genders)
description:
**About us**
------------

At GotPhoto, we are freeing photographers to be more successful.

Through our platforms GotPhoto.com and fotograf.de, we help professional photographers simplify and transform the way they work — from photo management and client communication to ordering and payment processing. Our end-to-end workflow and e-commerce solution gives photographers more time to focus on what matters most: being behind the lens.

Since 2012, we’ve built a sustainable and profitable business driven by entrepreneurial spirit, innovation, and a deep understanding of photographers’ everyday challenges. Today, thousands of photographers trust our software , creating their own success stories along the way.

As the leading e-commerce engine for professional volume photographers and a business backed by EQT, one of the world’s leading private equity firms, we’re powered by a team of 150+ talented and international people building technology that simplifies photographers’ everyday work and helps them focus on capturing meaningful moments.

Join us on our journey to empower photographers like never before.

**Your Role**
-------------

Do you want to drive turn everyday People administration into a seamless, high-quality experience for every single employee?

Are you ready to support both the operational engine and the talent growth of a fast-paced tech scale-up?

If you are a detail-oriented student who loves supporting people and keeping processes sharp by bringing employees and business needs together, **then you are our perfect match!**

Expect a steep learning curve, with experienced colleagues by your side. You will gain deep in-depth knowledge of the entire employee life cycle, from initial recruitment to the final stage of a successful career.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Support People Admin:** You help our People Operations with everyday employee inquiries, such as holidays, workations and learning budgets, and you keep our Jira Service Management tickets moving with speed and care.
* **Help Keep Data Accurate:** You support the maintenance of employee master data and digital personal files, following clear guidelines, so that everything stays accurate and up to date.
* **Document Support:** You prepare employment certificates, reference letters and other essential HR documents in German and English.
* **Talent Spotlight:** You help us look after the perfect candidate, from the first review of applications for junior roles to taking notes in interviews, so that the experience stays world-class.
* **Process Coordination:** You help the recruiting process run smoothly by scheduling interviews and following up with stakeholders to keep the momentum high.

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

**Experience**

* You are currently enrolled and studying Business Administration, Human Resources Management, Psychology, or a related subject.
* Initial experience in fast-paced companies or HR environment is a plus.
* Experience in a Tech Scale-up environment is a bonus.

**Skills**

* **Bilingual Proficiency:** You speak and write German and English at a professional level (C1/Native).
* **Organizational Talent:** You can juggle multiple tasks and projects without losing your cool or your attention to detail.
* **Tech Savvy:** You are comfortable (or eager to learn) working with tools like Personio, Leapsome, Jira, and Google Workspace.

**Mindset**

* **Detail Lover:** Accuracy is your quiet superpower.
* **Discreet & Trustworthy:** You handle sensitive data with care.
* **Eager Learner:** You see feedback as fuel.
* **You enjoy both working as part of the People Team and collaborating with it:** You come to our Berlin-Mitte office at least twice a week to work alongside us.

**Why You’ll Love Life at GotPhoto**
------------------------------------

* **Best of Both Worlds:** We live and breathe a flexible hybrid model. Our beautiful office at Hausvogteiplatz is our vibrant Berlin hub for collaboration, but you have the freedom to leverage the setup that works best for you.
* **Work from (Almost) Anywhere:** We believe in flexibility that respects your lifestyle. Once you have completed your probation, you have the option to work remotely from within Europe for up to 40 days per year. Whether you are visiting family or simply seeking a change of scenery, we support a work-from-anywhere culture that helps you stay inspired.
* **Recharge & Unwind:** We value your downtime. You start with 26 days of leave, plus we love to top that up with additional discretionary "X-days" to make sure you’re truly rested.
* **Multicultural & Inclusive Team:** We thrive on diverse perspectives. Our international team fosters a culture of mutual respect and professional exchange, ensuring that fresh ideas and tolerance are at the heart of everything we build together.
* **Fuel Your Growth:** We’re big on learning. You’ll get a dedicated education budget to explore new ideas and grow professionally.
* **Exclusive Employee Discounts:** Get more for your money with access to the "Benefits at Work" platform, offering significant discounts on top global brands.
* **Your Benefits, Your Choice:** Through Probonio, you get a monthly budget to spend on what matters to you—whether that’s your public transport pass or other flexible perks that fit your lifestyle.

**What Matters to Us**
----------------------

Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds may refrain from applying for positions if they feel they don't meet all qualifications. We strongly encourage you to apply if you’re interested: we're excited to discover how your distinctive experience can enhance our team!  
  
We work as one team. Wherever you come from. However, you identify. We believe in equal opportunities.

In my current role as a Junior Project Manager at Auto1 Group in Berlin, I work closely with product managers, developers, and regional operations leads across nine European markets. A core focus of my work has been conversational AI, where I supported the rollout and continuous tuning of our AI voice bot across 9 markets, routing millions of calls and increasing answer rates from 65% to 85%. I also manage the knowledge architecture and retrieval datasets for an AI chatbot handling over 30,000 monthly inquiries, and built an internal bulk-review QA platform to streamline how agents evaluate model quality.

Beyond day-to-day operations, I genuinely enjoy untangling disorganized datasets and creating solutions that make teams more efficient. In my analytics and reporting work, I frequently write SQL queries in Redash and build dashboards across Excel, Tableau, and Looker Studio so stakeholders have dependable, real-time metrics. When off-the-shelf software falls short, I roll up my sleeves to build lightweight internal tools, whether that means connecting internal systems through REST APIs, automating multi-step workflows, or testing and structuring custom evaluation data. Collaborating in an international Berlin environment has also allowed me to work comfortably across languages, using my native Spanish, fluent English, and working German (B1).

What particularly excites me about GotPhoto is the opportunity to bring this mix of analytical curiosity and builder execution to your team. Thank you very much for taking the time to review my application. I would welcome the chance to speak with you and discuss how my background can support GotPhoto in this role.
