title: SAP iXp Intern (f/m/d) - Adoption & Consumption Operations
description:
**We help the world run better**
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
  
  
**About The Role**
You'll support the team in two areas: how we run our projects, and how we work with data. You'll use AI tools, agents and skills every day to prepare meetings, summarize outcomes, analyze data and automate recurring tasks, and you'll help us find new ways to apply them.
  
  
In project management, your focus will be on post-merger integration: you'll help integrate portfolios that SAP has acquired. This is a good fit if you like structure, enjoy working with people, are curious about what the numbers show, and want hands-on experience with AI in a real business setting.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Project management & post-merger integration:
  
  

* Support project management for the post-merger integration of acquired portfolios by tracking timelines, dependencies and open points across workstreams
* Organize and prepare team and stakeholder meetings, including agendas, materials, notes and follow-ups
* Keep the project action trackers up to date and help make sure open items get followed up
* Summarize outcomes, decisions and next steps, and share them with the right audiences
* Maintain project status materials and updates for leadership reviews

**Analytics & Reporting**

* Create ad-hoc reports and analyses that answer business questions from the team and stakeholders
* Help maintain and improve dashboards in SAP Analytics Cloud and other BI tools
* Gather and document requirements for new reports or enhancements
* Identify ways to automate recurring reporting tasks based on AI Agents & Skills

**What You’ll Bring**
We’re looking for someone who takes the initiative, perseveres, and stays curious. You like to work on meaningful innovative projects and are energized by lifelong learning.
  
  

* Currently enrolled in a Master's program in business, economics, information systems or a related field
* Strong organizational skills: you keep track of details and follow through
* Clear, structured communication in English, both written and spoken, German is a plus
* An analytical mindset and confidence working with data in Excel or similar tools
* Solid PowerPoint skills
* Previous internship or working student experience in operations, consulting, project management or analytics
* A proactive attitude and the confidence to ask questions and suggest improvements
* Working from Berlin office is required. If you are applying from outside the area, please mention your relocation plans or preferences in your CV (Relocation costs are not reimbursed by the manager/employer)

**Nice To Have**

* First experience with BI tools such as SAP Analytics Cloud, Power BI or Tableau
* Interest & first experience in using AI tools to work more efficiently

**Where You Belong**
Be part of SAP Next Gen, a global community for students, universities, schools and educational partners, who are passionate about innovation and technology.
  
  

* Culture of Collaboration: Partner with experienced SAP colleagues and expert mentors who will support your growth. Grow professionally through personalized mentoring, coaching, and career development support.
* Project-driven Experience: Kickstart your career with hands-on learning experience, making an impact from day one by contributing to meaningful projects that help the world run better. You’ll have endless learning resources at your fingertips and gain future-ready skills from a variety of virtual, in-person, and hybrid learning sessions, cultivated just for you, and aligned with our learning approach.
* Gain Visibility: Build relationships with leaders and peers across teams and functions. Showcase your ideas, skills, and creativity in a global, fast-paced environment. Open doors for future career opportunities within SAP and beyond.

**The Team**
**The Adoption & Consumption Practices And Platform Team**

* Lives end-to-end responsibility for business practices such as solution adoption planning, demand generation, renewal risk management
* Defines supporting infrastructure for customer-facing colleagues for improving customer satisfaction and driving adoption and consumption of our solutions
* Manages business requirements from customer-facing roles on systems, processes and analytics in close collaboration with the internal IT organization
* Introduces innovative instruments built on the newest technologies such as Artificial Intelligence to customer success management teams

*Follow @LifeatSAP on Instagram and don't miss anything about our experiences worldwide!*
*#SAPNextGen*
**Bring out your best**
SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.
  
  
**We win with inclusion**
SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.
  
  
SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.
  
  
For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.
  
  
**AI Usage in the Recruitment Process**
For information on the responsible use of AI in our recruitment process, please refer to our Guidelines for Ethical Usage of AI in the Recruiting Process.
  
  
Please note that any violation of these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process.

title: Working Student Global Inclusion (m/w/d)
description:
**Title** : Working Student Global Inclusion

**Location** : Berlin

**Application Deadline** : 10. November 2026

**About Springer Nature**

Springer Nature opens the doors to discovery for researchers, educators, clinicians and other professionals. Every day, around the globe, our imprints, books, journals, platforms and technology solutions reach millions of people. For over 180 years our brands and imprints have been a trusted source of knowledge to these communities and today, more than ever, we see it as our responsibility to ensure that fundamental knowledge can be found, verified, understood and used by our communities – enabling them to improve outcomes, make progress, and benefit the generations that follow. Visit springernature.com and follow @SpringerNature

**About the Role**

Are you a student looking for hands-on experience in promoting inclusion within a global organization? If so, this role might be perfect for you! As a working student, you will support Springer Nature’s Global Inclusion Team in developing and implementing global initiatives in areas such as learning and development, communication, employee network support, research and data analysis metrics. You will take ownership of subprojects and gain valuable experience in an international, dynamic environment.

Join our enthusiastic and supportive team of four, where you’ll have the opportunity to work independently on meaningful projects. We offer a collaborative workplace, access to different learning offers and a variety of community events, as well as a book discount of 15–40%.

  

**Role Responsibilities**

* Support participant management for events and training programs, applying **adult learning principles** to help develop engaging and effective training materials.
* Support reporting of engagement & inclusion surveys through data analysis and tracking recurring metrics.
* Prepare research, content, and communication materials for Inclusion initiatives, leveraging **storytelling** and **effective communication** skills to create compelling emails, blog posts, and other communications.
* Schedule and organize events and campaigns, utilizing strong **collaboration** and **project management skills** to ensure successful planning and execution.
* Support community management activities, including employee networks, by demonstrating **interpersonal awareness** and **valuing differences** to create inclusive and engaging communities.
* Provide general project management support, applying a **global perspective** while partnering with diverse stakeholders and contributing to the successful delivery of Inclusion initiatives.

**Experience, Skills and Qualifications**

* Enrolled in a degree in economics, politics, communication, sociology, social science or related disciplines, or in gender and diversity studies

* A good understanding of the field of diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging

* Some experience with project management

* A hands-on, committed and solution-oriented work approach

* Strong written and verbal communication skills

* Fluency in English or German: English is the main language in this area but ideally, we are looking for a candidate who can also provide support in German

Sound working knowledge of MS 365 programmes  



The position is offered on a part-time, fixed-term contract basis, and will be based on a hybrid model in our Berlin offices.

  

Please note we will be reviewing candidate applications as they are submitted and so encourage you to apply as early as possible.

  

At Springer Nature, our mission is to be part of progress – and that begins with inclusion: of people, perspectives, and ideas. We believe that diverse perspectives drive progress, and we are committed to creating an environment where people and ideas can flourish. If you have any access needs related to disability, neurodivergence or a chronic condition, please contact us so we can make all necessary accommodation. Find out more about our DEI work here: https://group.springernature.com/gp/group/taking-responsibility/diversity-equity-inclusion .

For more information about career opportunities in Springer Nature please visit https://springernature.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/SpringerNatureCareers/ .

title: Mandatory Internship – Technical Project Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
**About ecopals**
-----------------

ecopals is building the leading performance additive platform for asphalt and bitumen modification, engineered for regional, sovereign supply chains and backed by strong unit economics. Our current product line is built on high-performance polymers, with further additive categories in active development. In the last two years, we have scaled to active operations in more than 10 EU countries, and we are now pushing decisively into Eastern Europe, CEE and North Africa.

As we enter our next growth phase, we are opening a mandatory internship position for **Technical Project Engineer (m/f/d)**. The role works closely with our R&D, commercial and management teams and supports the implementation of technical projects across suppliers, laboratories, development partners and customers.

The position is particularly suited to someone who enjoys combining engineering, project coordination and analytical work, and who can help move technical projects from an initial concept toward testing, documentation and implementation.

**Tasks**
---------

In this internship, you will support the development and execution of technical projects around ecopals' products and applications. A key part of the role is helping coordinate the different internal and external parties involved and ensuring that technical activities, information and next steps continue moving forward.

**Areas of responsibility**

* **Technical project coordination.** Supporting the planning and execution of development and application projects, including timelines, technical requirements, responsibilities and next steps.
* **Supplier and partner coordination.** Working with material suppliers, laboratories, manufacturers and technical partners to request information, clarify requirements, follow up on open topics and help keep projects progressing.
* **Project communication and follow-up.** Preparing and following up on emails, technical requests, meeting notes, action points and documentation required from internal and external stakeholders.
* **Technical applications.** Translating R&D results and product knowledge into practical recommendations, formulations, dosage concepts and application guidelines for different projects and markets.
* **Testing and experimental support.** Supporting test programmes and external laboratory work, preparing material samples for laboratories and customers, assisting with in-house experimental setups, and helping collect and evaluate results.
* **Technical documentation.** Preparing technical reports, product documentation, project summaries, presentations and supporting materials for customers, partners and internal decision making.
* **Technical and economic analysis.** Supporting the evaluation of materials, production routes, project costs, CO₂ reduction and the technical-economic value of different solutions.
* **Data analysis and management.** Structuring project and experimental data and supporting the maintenance of internal technical databases and project records.
* **Tools, automation and AI-assisted workflows.** Using Excel, programming and modern AI-assisted tools where appropriate to support technical evaluations, data handling, reporting, research and project workflows, while ensuring that outputs are properly checked and documented.
* **Independent work packages.** Taking ownership of defined project tasks and helping drive them from initial request through completion.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Advanced studies, preferably at Master’s level, in **Industrial Engineering, Process Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Materials Engineering, Construction Materials** or a comparable technical field. A combination of **engineering and business-related studies**, such as an engineering Bachelor’s degree followed by a Master’s in Business, Management or a related discipline, is also particularly welcome.
* A good understanding of **engineering processes, materials and/or industrial production systems**.
* **At least two years of relevant experience in one or more of the activities described above**, gained through internships, research projects, student assistant positions, industrial projects or professional experience.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to structure technical information, identify open questions and translate them into concrete next steps.
* A structured and reliable way of working, with a strong sense of ownership and attention to follow-up.
* Comfortable coordinating with different internal and external stakeholders and keeping track of multiple parallel workstreams.
* Strong written communication skills and the ability to prepare clear technical documentation for different audiences.
* Good command of Excel and other analytical tools.
* **Basic programming or data-analysis skills**, particularly Python, are a strong plus. Experience with AI-assisted coding or AI agents is welcome but not required. We expect candidates to be comfortable learning these workflows quickly and using them diligently, including checking outputs, validating calculations and maintaining clear, reproducible work.
* Fluent English; German is a strong plus.
* An entrepreneurial and hands-on mindset, with an interest in turning technical ideas into practical and commercially viable solutions.

**Your benefits**
-----------------

* **Direct involvement in real technical projects**, working across R&D, suppliers, laboratories, partners and commercial teams.
* **Responsibility from an early stage**, with ownership of defined work packages and project follow-up.
* **A steep learning curve** across engineering, project execution, materials, sustainability and commercialization.
* **Exposure to industrial product implementation**, from technical concept and supplier discussions through experimental work, testing and customer documentation.
* **Proximity to decision making**, working closely with R&D and company leadership.
* **Exposure to modern AI-assisted technical workflows**, including practical use of automation, data analysis and AI agents in day-to-day engineering work.
* **International exposure**, supporting projects and partners across different markets.
* **Hybrid work in Berlin**, with occasional laboratory, supplier or project visits where relevant.
* **Meaningful impact**, contributing to technologies designed to reduce emissions and improve the resource efficiency of critical infrastructure.

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Digital Health
description:
**DEMECAN – Wir kultivieren Lebensqualität**

DEMECAN, unser Name steht für Deutsches Medizinal-Cannabis. Unser Ziel ist es, die Lebensqualität von Patient:innen zu verbessern, indem ihnen der Zugang zu medizinischem Cannabis in „Made in Germany“-Qualität ermöglicht wird. Im Mai 2019 erhielt DEMECAN als einziges unabhängiges deutsches Unternehmen den Zuschlag zur Produktion von medizinischem Cannabis in Deutschland. In der Nähe von Dresden haben wir das Zentrum für medizinisches Cannabis mit einem modernen Indoor-Gewächshaus aufgebaut. Dort wachsen und blühen derzeit unsere exklusiven Cannabispflanzen.

Wir verstehen uns als Pionier und Experte im Bereich Cannabis. Leistung, Initiative und Verantwortung zeichnet unsere Mitarbeiter:innen und unser Team aus. Durch flache Hierarchien und eine offene Feedback-Kultur hat jede:r im Team die Möglichkeit, unsere Entwicklung mitzugestalten und medizinisches Cannabis in Deutschland zu einer Erfolgsstory zu machen. Geh' mit uns den nächsten Schritt in Deiner Karriere und bewirb Dich bei uns.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Berlin suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Werkstudent (m/w/d) Digital Health.

**Was wir bieten:**

* flexible Arbeitszeiten (10–15 Std./Woche) in unserem Büro in Berlin oder mobil
* einen abwechslungsreichen Job mit großen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten bei dem einzigen unabhängigen deutschen Hersteller von medizinischem Cannabis
* echten Gestaltungsspielraum statt fertiger Vorgaben: Du bestimmst mit, wohin sich Deine Aufgaben entwickeln
* thematische und technische Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem wachsenden Unternehmen - mit Perspektive in Richtung unserer zentralen Datenplattform
* kurze Wege und direkten Austausch bis zur Geschäftsführung
* ein kreativ-dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld mit einem freundlichen und professionellen Team
* Benefits wie: Frisches Obst, kostenlose Getränke, hundefreundliches Büro, Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft und Möglichkeiten zur individuellen Weiterbildung

**Was du mitbringst:**

* Du befindest Dich in einem laufenden Studium, idealerweise mit Bezug zu Wirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Gesundheitsökonomie oder Vergleichbarem
* Du gehst sicher mit Excel oder Google Sheets um (Filter, Pivot, Auswertungen) - SQL- oder BI-Kenntnisse (z. B. Power BI) sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung
* Du hast Freude an Zahlen und einen Blick für Zusammenhänge
* Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenständig und willst mitgestalten, nicht nur ausführen
* Du nutzt aktuelle AI-Werkzeuge selbstverständlich und erkennst, wann ein Ergebnis belastbar ist und wann es geprüft gehört
* Sorgfalt in der Datenpflege, Verbindlichkeit gegenüber Partnern und ein diskreter Umgang mit sensiblen Daten sind für Dich selbstverständlich
* Du bringst sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse mit

**Deine Aufgaben:**

* Du baust Reportings auf und entwickelst sie weiter, mit denen wir die Entwicklung unserer Partnerapotheken verstehen: Bestellvolumen, Entwicklung über die Zeit, Lieferzeiten
* Du bestimmst mit, welche Kennzahlen wir betrachten, und dokumentierst sie nachvollziehbar
* Du beobachtest, wie sich Sortimente und Nachfrage entwickeln, und leitest daraus Erkenntnisse für das Team ab
* Du lieferst Analysen dazu, in welchen Regionen weitere Partnerschaften sinnvoll sind
* Du führst unser Vertragsregister und behältst Laufzeiten und Fristen im Blick
* Du vereinfachst und automatisierst wiederkehrende Abläufe mit Tabellen, Workflows oder AI-Werkzeugen
* Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Apothekenbetreuung zusammen und entlastest so unser Key Account Management

Wenn Du mit uns Großes erreichen möchtest, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung mit Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, Immatrikulationsbescheinigung und der Info, ab wann Du mit wie vielen Stunden bis voraussichtlich wann DEMECANNON werden willst.

title: Strategy and Operations Project Intern (GBS) - 2026 (BS/MS)
description:
**Responsibilities**
About The Team:
  
  
The Global Monetization Strategy & Operations (MSO) team is a high-impact unit at the center of TikTok’s global advertising business. We partner with senior leaders to shape strategy, set revenue plans, design incentive policies, and build the operational foundations that enable TikTok to scale. Our work spans markets and functions, requiring sharp problem-solving, rigorous analysis, and the ability to execute in complex environments.
  
  
As an MSO intern, you will join a small, high-performing team where you will be entrusted with meaningful responsibilities from day one. You will contribute to projects with direct visibility to leadership, gain experience across multiple markets, and build a skill set that sits at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and operations.
  
  
As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short-term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real-world experience. You will gain practical skills through on-the-job learning in a fast-paced work environment and develop a deeper understanding of your career interests. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.
  
  
Responsibilities：
  
  

* Develop and deliver analytical reports to track KPIs, evaluate sales performance, and surface insights that shape leadership decisions.
* Conduct research and market sizing across industries, translating findings into clear strategic recommendations.
* Support the design and rollout of regional initiatives that increase sales effectiveness and operational scalability.

title: Working Student (m/w/d) - Cyber Security Engineering
description:
As a leading global software product company in Compliance & Automation, IMTF Group develops innovative RegTech solutions focusing on Anti-Money Laundering, Know Your Customer, and Anti-Fraud. Our technology helps financial institutions fight financial crime and meet demanding regulatory requirements.

At IMTF, we value innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning. We encourage our teams to explore new technologies, challenge existing approaches, and continuously improve how we develop and deliver secure software.

As a Working Student in Cyber Security Engineering, you will join our Research & Development organization and help improve the security tools we develop and use internally. You will work on vulnerability scanners, security automation, and supporting software that helps us identify, assess, and address security risks across our products.

This is a hands-on software engineering role where you can apply your academic knowledge to real-world security challenges.

### **Responsibilities**

* Develop and enhance our internal security tools, including vulnerability scanners and automated security checks
* Improve vulnerability detection, analysis, and reporting to deliver accurate and actionable security findings
* Help automate security assessments of applications, dependencies, containers, and infrastructure
* Contribute to tools and processes for software supply chain security, including SBOM and vulnerability management
* Research emerging vulnerabilities, attack techniques, and security technologies and evaluate their relevance to our software
* Integrate security tools and automated checks into our development and CI/CD workflows
* Collaborate with software engineers to improve the effectiveness and reliability of our security tooling
* Explore opportunities to leverage AI and automation to make security analysis more efficient

  
**Requirements**  

* Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Cyber Security, IT Security, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
* Basic programming skills, preferably in Python, and an interest in developing real-world software
* Foundational understanding of IT security, networking, operating systems, and common software vulnerabilities
* Interest in vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, and DevSecOps practices
* Familiarity with Linux, Git, or container technologies is an advantage
* Curiosity about security tools, automation, and emerging technologies
* Analytical thinking, strong problem-solving skills, and a hands-on approach
* Interest in using modern AI-assisted development tools
* Ability to work independently while actively collaborating with a development team
* Good communication skills in English; German language skills are an advantage

Previous professional experience in Cyber Security is not required. We value curiosity, practical problem-solving skills, and a willingness to learn.

 **Benefits**  

* **Make the World Safer:** Help us strengthen the security of software used to combat financial crime
* **Be Part of an Established RegTech:** Gain practical experience at an international Swiss software company
* **Hands-on Engineering:** Work on real security software and contribute improvements that make a measurable difference
* **Ownership and Development:** Take responsibility for your work, learn from experienced engineers, and develop your technical skills
* **Paid Further Education:** Benefit from opportunities to expand your knowledge and professional capabilities
* **International Exposure:** Collaborate with colleagues across different countries and engineering disciplines

The anticipated salary for this Working Student - Cyber Engineering position in Germany is EUR 18,000 gross per year, based on a 20-hour working week (50% employment level).

At IMTF, we are committed to treating all candidates with respect and equality, regardless of gender, religion, nationality, or any other characteristic. We embrace diversity and inclusion as integral parts of our organizational culture and welcome candidates from all backgrounds.

description:

* Du wirkst im Transformation Office bei Projektmanagement- und Governance-Aktivitäten für unser unternehmensweites Transformationsprogramm mit und arbeitest dabei mit verschiedenen Projektteams und Funktionen zusammen.

* Du bist aktuell in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudiengang eingeschrieben – unabhängig von deiner Fachrichtung.
* Du hast bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen durch Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeiten oder andere relevante Tätigkeiten gesammelt.
* Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
* Du bringst sehr gute organisatorische und administrative Fähigkeiten mit und hast Freude daran, Aufgaben zu koordinieren, Fristen im Blick zu behalten und strukturiert zu arbeiten.
* Du gehst sicher mit MS-Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel, um und hast großes Interesse an KI und Automatisierung – idealerweise hast du bereits praktische Erfahrung mit Tools wie ChatGPT gesammelt.
* Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und sorgfältig und fühlst dich in der Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Teams und Stakeholdern in einem internationalen Umfeld wohl.

Simon-Kucher ist eine globale Unternehmensberatung mit mehr als 2.200 Mitarbeitenden in über 30 Ländern. title: Digital Transformation Internship
description:
Job ID: 704874

Digital Transformation Internship

Berlin

Student internship

Internship

T-Systems International GmbH

  

**Internship at Telekom**

  

Do you want to put the theory you have learned into practice and experience and help shape the digital world of tomorrow today? Then you've come to the right place! We can make and copy coffee ourselves; we are looking for interns like you who want to advance the connected world every day with team spirit, a willingness to innovate and perform!

  
  

**T-Systems International GmbH**

  

At T-Systems, we offer our business customers the right system solutions for their digital business. With our portfolio, we ensure that digital transformation reduces complexity, saves costs and makes everyday work easier. Our focus is connectivity, digital, cloud & infrastructure as well as security - Let's power higher performance!

  
  

**About the position**

  

As an intern (m/f/d/x) in the area of digital transformation, you will actively shape the digital transformation in our company. You will be involved in strategic and operational transformation projects right from the start and support our team in analyzing existing processes and implementing sustainable digital solutions.

  
  

**Your tasks**

  

**Whether it's a mandatory or voluntary internship — As an intern (m/f/d/x), you will definitely benefit from attractive remuneration and will support the team with the following responsible tasks from 01.01.2027:**

  

* Active support for strategic digitization and change management initiatives
* Preparation of analyses, dashboards and management presentations using MS Excel and PowerPoint
* Accompaniment of process optimizations and independent promotion of sub-projects
* Interfacing and communication with various internal stakeholders
* Introducing fresh ideas and innovative impulses for the continuous development of our working methods
  

  

**Your profile**

  

You are studying communication sciences, marketing, business administration, a comparable degree program or are in a gap year.

  
  

You also have the following knowledge and skills:

  
  

* **Safe use of MS Office:** In particular, profound knowledge of Excel for data preparation and PowerPoint for creating meaningful presentations
* **Distinctive analytical skills:** Enjoying the structured understanding of complex relationships and deriving recommendations for action
* **Basic understanding of change management:** Great interest in transformation processes and accompanying organizational changes
* **Proactive and independent way of working:** High level of initiative, curiosity and hands-on mentality when faced with new challenges
* **Very good language skills:** Fluent written and spoken German and English
  

  

**Ideally, you should bring that with you**

  

* First practical experience (e.g. through internships or working student activities) in the area of digitization, process optimization or project management
* Basic understanding of agile working methods and methods (e.g. Scrum, Kanban)
* First points of contact with collaboration and project management tools (e.g. Jira, Confluence, Miro, MS Teams)
* Affinity for new technologies and digital trends
  

  

**What we offer**

  

* **Practical insights:** Real responsibility and exciting insights into strategic transformation and digitization projects
* **Mentoring & feedback:** Individual support and regular feedback to promote your personal and professional development
* **Central location:** A modern workplace in the heart of Berlin with excellent public transport connections
* **Team culture:** An open, dynamic team with flat hierarchies, regular team events and an appreciative atmosphere

title: Venture Development - Intern
description:
**About Us**
Founded in Berlin,
**autarc**
is a ~80-person start-up that graduated from Y Combinator in San Francisco. Our team spans Sales, Tech, and Operations. We build software that helps energy installers plan, sell, and deliver home electrification projects faster and with higher quality.
  
  
**Your Impact**
Are you excited to work on strategic projects that accelerate the energy transition?
  
  
If you're excited about green-tech, cross-functional projects, and exploring scalable solutions, join us and make an impact.
  
  
You will work closely with the co-founder, our Venture Development Lead whilst collaborating with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Tech to drive new initiatives from idea to launch. This role is built for someone who likes ownership, moves fast, and learns directly from customers.
  
  
Please note: This position is
**on-site in Berlin (Mitte) and C2-level proficiency in German is required.**
What you’ll do
  
  

* Own early product management and cross-team execution for new initiatives: shape value propositions, define MVPs, prioritize features, align stakeholders, and coordinate Sales, Marketing, and Tech for fast, smooth launches
* Dive quickly into new topics, markets, and customer problems, building a deep understanding through frequent, direct customer conversations
* Hands-on drive the launch of new digital products and services - from first idea to market rollout - working closely with the co-founders and team
* Talk to customers daily to uncover pain points, validate solutions, and actively promote, position, and upsell new products and features while iterating based on real-world feedback
* Support go-to-market execution with sales decks, presentations, and customer-facing materials, and help the team communicate new value clearly
* Work closely with Product and Design to translate market/customer requirements into concrete product improvements and launch assets

**What You Bring**

* Graduated from a strong university; entrepreneurial mindset
* Fluent in English and C2 German (required)
* Experience in a startup environment (or similarly fast-paced setting)
* Hands-on: you execute, not just coordinate
* Curious about how tech, operations, and business strategy come together in high-growth companies
* Structured thinker who’s not afraid to get into details, run the numbers, and execute fast
* Based in Berlin and willing to work on-site (office in Mitte) for min. 5 months

**What We Offer**

* Freedom to choose your own equipment
* An annual team retreat
* The choice between Dance or Deutschland Ticket for mobility
* Urban Sports Club for fitness
* Regular team events, lunches and activities

**Next steps**
If your application is successful, you will participate in the following:
  
  

* Screening call with Venture Deveopment Lead
* Culture fit call with Thies (Co-Founder)
* Take home case study (approx. 1 hour)
* Final on-site interview with the team

**About Us**
Heating our buildings causes around 25% of Europe's CO₂ emissions. Decarbonizing it depends on installers – and there are far too few of them to keep up with the growing demand for heat pumps.
  
  
autarc is building the operating system for energy installers across Europe: software that makes planning, designing and installing heat pumps faster and more digital. Our goal is to help plan and design 1 million heat pumps by 2030.
  
  
Founded in Berlin and backed by Y Combinator (S24), we're a team of 60+ people across Sales, Tech and Operations, already serving more than 2,000 customers.

title: Werkstudent (w/m/d) KI-gestützte Software- und Plattformentwicklung
description:
**Gemeinsam machen wir den Unterschied**
**Siemens Mobility**
ist ein eigenständig geführtes Unternehmen der Siemens AG und seit über 160 Jahren ein führender Anbieter im Bereich Mobilität. Zu unserem Kerngeschäft gehören Schienenfahrzeuge, Bahnautomatisierungs- und Elektrifizierungslösungen, schlüsselfertige Systeme sowie die dazugehörigen Serviceleistungen. Wir waren schon immer sehr innovativ, um Reisen schneller, sicherer und komfortabler zu machen. Heute brauchen wir neue Lösungen für neue Herausforderungen wie den Klimawandel und weltweit steigende Bevölkerungszahlen. Das ist es, was uns antreibt. Deshalb gestalten wir Mobilität mit Leidenschaft und sind immer einen Schritt voraus. Durch Digitalisierung machen wir Infrastrukturen intelligent und schaffen Möglichkeiten, die uns nachhaltig und nahtlos von A nach B bringen. Unsere über 40.000 Mitarbeitenden sind Pioniere im Mobilitätswesen, die dabei helfen, die Welt in Bewegung zu halten.
  
  
**Was trägst Du bei?**
Du möchtest neben dem Studium einen Einblick in ein Entwicklungs- und Plattformteam gewinnen und herausfinden, wie KI sinnvoll für die Entwicklung in großen Organisationen eingesetzt werden kann? In unserem Team arbeitest du an der Weiterentwicklung von Anwendungen und Services im Bereich Softwareentwicklung und KI. Dabei kannst du eigene Ideen einbringen und bekommst viele Gelegenheiten, Dich auch mit KI, DevOps und Cloud-Technologien zu beschäftigen.
  
  
Hierfür suchen wir einen Werkstudenten (w/m/d) für den Standort Braunschweig und einen Werkstudenten (w/m/d) für den Standort Berlin.
  
  

* Bei uns entwickelst und pflegst Du Software- und Plattformkomponenten. Dabei arbeitest du hauptsächlich mit Rust oder Python, gegebenenfalls auch mit anderen Sprachen wie Go oder JavaScript.
* Du unterstützt bei der Konzeption und Umsetzung neuer Funktionen sowie bei der Behebung von Fehlern.
* Du lernst, Systeme zu entwickeln und KI-Agenten für die Softwareentwicklung zu orchestrieren.
* Du tauschst Dich im Team über technische Ansätze aus und bringst Verbesserungsvorschläge ein.
* Je nach Interesse und Projektbedarf wirkst Du an KI-Anwendungen, automatisierten Entwicklungsabläufen oder Cloud-Themen mit.

**Was bringst Du mit?**

* Du studierst Informatik oder Software-Engineering und kannst uns längerfristig unterstützen.
* Du hast praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit Rust oder Python, zum Beispiel durch Projekte, Praktika oder Deine bisherige Arbeit. Alternativ kannst Du sehr gute Kenntnisse in einer anderen Programmiersprache vorweisen.
* Du hast erste Berührungspunkte mit DevOps-Techniken, zum Beispiel CI/CD, Containerisierung oder Automatisierung gesammelt.
* Vorteilhaft sind zudem erste Erfahrungen mit den gängigen KI-Anwendungen, etwa mit Machine Learning, Sprachmodellen und KI-APIs.
* Des Weiteren sind Kenntnisse in Cloud-Technologien, insbesondere im Open-Source-Bereich (z.B. Kubernetes, Docker, GitLab und Terraform/OpenTofu), ein Plus.
* Gute Deutsch- und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab.

**Was bieten wir Dir?**
Inklusion & Vielfalt
  
  
Bei Siemens Mobility setzen wir uns engagiert für Gerechtigkeit und Gleichberechtigung ein. Vielfalt bereichert unser Team und fördert innovative Lösungen. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung.
  
  
Purpose
  
  
Wir sind Pioniere der Mobilität. Bei uns trägst Du in einem Zukunftsmarkt aktiv zu Verkehrswende und Klimaschutz bei, weil unsere Transportlösungen in aller Welt den CO2-Ausstoß verringern.
  
  
Mobiles Arbeiten /Remote Working
  
  
Bei uns hast Du die Möglichkeit, hybrid zu arbeiten. Das bedeutet, dass Du zu einem erheblichen Anteil mobil tätig sein kannst. Dies haben wir durch eine Betriebsvereinbarung offiziell geregelt.
  
  
Attraktive Konditionen
  
  
Bei uns erhältst Du eine attraktive Vergütung. Du startest mit circa 15 € je Stunde und erhältst ab dem 7. Monat circa 19 €.
  
  
Eine Übersicht über unsere Benefits findest Du hier.
  
  
**Wie trittst Du mit uns in Kontakt?**
**www.siemens.de/mobility**
wenn Du vor Deiner Bewerbung mehr über Siemens Mobility erfahren möchtest.
  
  
**www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/faq.html**
wenn Du Informationen rund um das Thema Bewerbung mittels unseres FAQ’s einholen möchtest.
  
  
**+49 (9131) 17 5243-0**
wenn Du über unsere Bewerberhotline weitere Fragen zur Stelle klären möchtest.
  
  
**www.siemens.com/mobility-jobs**
wenn Du mehr Informationen zu Jobs & Karriere bei Siemens erhalten möchtest.
  
  
Wir legen Wert auf Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung.
  
  
Ansprechpartner für diese Stellenausschreibung ist Frau Christin Hitz.

title: Working Student (m/f/d) Data Scientist and Programmer
description:
**A Day in Your Life at Atotech Deutschland GmbH & Co. KG**

As a Working Student (m/f/d) Data Scientist and Programmer, you will partner with R&D engineers and internal stakeholders to develop a user-friendly desktop graphical user interface for FASET, an existing statistical analysis backend for copper surface facet evaluation. You will integrate existing C/C++ functionality into an application and support efficient, reproducible analysis, visualization, data handling, and export. In this role, you will report to the responsible manager within R&D Electronics.

**You Will Make an Impact By**

* Analyzing the existing C/C++ FASET core code and integrating it into a desktop GUI
* Translating user requirements into functional specifications and intuitive software workflows
* Developing and testing front-end functions for parameter input, image visualization, mapping, optimization, and results review
* Implementing asynchronous program execution, project data management, metadata handling, logging, configuration, and file handling
* Improving the performance of computationally intensive analysis and coordinate-mapping functions
* Creating clean, maintainable, version-controlled, and well-documented code

**Skills You Bring**

* Enrolled student (m/f/d) in computer science, data science, or a comparable technical degree program
* Programming knowledge
* Basic experience with graphical user interfaces
* Understanding of software development, testing, debugging, and version control
* Analytical thinking and the ability to understand scientific or engineering workflows
* Good written and spoken English; German skills are beneficial

**Preferred Skills**

* experiences in programming

**Physical Demands and Working Conditions**

* Regular use of standard office and computer equipment
* Ability to communicate technical information clearly and accurately

title: Tax & Finance Operations Interns (f/m/d) - AI Tax Startup
description:
We are building Germany's leading Tax Advisory firm. Taxforce was founded based on a simple observation: Many business owners want a tax advisor who acts as a true sparring partner: proactive, responsive, and strategic. What they often get instead is a service provider: booking receipts and filing tax returns, with little real advisory.

We’re building the alternative.

Founded in 2025, Taxforce rethinks tax advisory from the ground up: AI-powered and highly automated, yet personal. We’re starting with healthcare professionals, a complex and underserved segment, with the ambition to expand into many more industries over time.

Instead of pure compliance, we deliver real advisory and become long-term partners to our clients: from initial setup to established organizations.

This is a €40B market in Germany alone, with processes that have barely changed in decades. AI is now enabling a fundamental shift and there are no playbooks yet. We’re writing them.

We’re a small, highly ambitious team in Berlin, backed by €5M from Tenet VC and founded by alumni of Goldman Sachs, Harvard Business School, Bain & Company and the former Klarna Head of Engineering. You’ll work directly with the founders, take on real responsibility from day one, and see how AI transforms a real-world industry.

We offer a high-ownership environment, direct feedback and mentoring, a collaborative team, and competitive salary all from our office near Boxhagener Platz.

Join early and help us redefine tax advisory.

**Tasks**
---------

**As a Tax & Finance Intern, you'll work right in the middle of our operational and advisory tax work**. You'll take on responsibility from day one, both **e**xternally, supporting our tax advisors, and internally, in our own controlling and bookkeeping along the entire value chain: from preparing client tax returns and hands-on research, to managing invoicing, funds, and cashflow, through our monthly internal financial close. Because tech and tax work together at Taxforce, you'll be close to the point where manual work turns into automation and you'll actively help us make our processes better: :

**Finance & controlling**

* Take ownership of our invoicing and support funds and cashflow management
* Support the monthly internal bookkeeping and financial close
* Build and maintain reporting and controlling analyses over time

**Tax Operational work**

* Prepare ongoing financial accounting: receipt capture, booking, account reconciliation
* Prepare annual financial statement packages and business analyses: Provide simple input on tax returns and pre-filings (income tax, business taxes) at draft level, where you get feedback and develop new skills
* Support our digital mail and tax assessment processing through deadline control and smart document classification
* Structured client communication (document requests, follow-ups)
* Maintain client master data and support deadline contro

**Tech & automation**

* Test and document internal tools and workflows
* Contribute to automating recurring tasks (e.g. document classification, data extraction, integrations)
* Data preparation and simple analyses

**Requirements**
----------------

* **Drive & ambition:** You're excited to work motivated to work in a young team and thrive in fast-paced startup environments.
* **Relevant studies:** You're studying business administration, economics, law, tax or a related field, ideally with a focus on or strong interest in tax, accounting or finance
* **First practical experience:** You've gained hands-on experience through internships or working student roles (ideally in Tax, Accounting, Finance or Consulting)
* **Care & accuracy:** You work carefully and precisely, because in tax and finance every detail counts
* **Structured & independent:** You organise yourself well, prioritise between tasks and get things done without needing everything spelled out
* **Tech-savvy:** You're comfortable using AI tools and can implement small automations yourself and you have no problem with learning new tools and skills on the go
* **Collaborative:** You are a team player. Working together as a team and sharing knowledge comes naturally to you
* **German language skills:** We are a fast growing start-up with a diverse team. However, our customers do mostly speak German. Hence we require German language skills.

**Benefits**
------------

* **Learn from an experienced team:** Work closely with founders and tax advisors and get direct feedback and mentoring from day one
* **Ownership from day one**: Take on real responsibility early and help shape how Taxforce is built across tax, finance, and operations
* **Front-row seat to AI in the real world**: See how AI is applied to transform a traditional industry and actively contribute to building an AI-driven product
* **Steep learning curve:** Work on real clients and real numbers, not example cases, and build skills that carry into your career
* **Strong team environment**: Join an ambitious, supportive team with direct feedback and a high level of trust and ownership
* **Fair working student salary and a great office:** Competitive pay and flexible hours around your studies, from our office near Boxhagener Platz

**Office Policy:** We work 5 days in the office, because we feel that is crucial to enable speed, learning, and compounding interests when working next to each other.

description:
**Working Student Master Data Management (m/w/d)**
==================================================

**Field of Work:** Data Management,
  
**Location:** Berlin  
**Legal Entity:** KWS Berlin GmbH

**Job ID:** 16983

**KWS Berlin GmbH** is looking for a **Working Student - Master Data Management Materials & Production Master(m/f/d).** In this role, you will support the Master Data Management team in maintaining master data in the areas of the business (materials, production, logistics and purchasing) while adhering to standards and governance to ensure data is compliant with defined information, policies, and quality requirements as defined by the data owner.

This opportunity is **20 hours/week for 12 months** with possibility for extension.

**Your Tasks:**

* Create and maintain standard operating procedures and training documentation and perform end-user training.
* Complete tasks in work queue as assigned according to agreed SLA.
* Initiate and carry out regular data cleansing activities to ensure high level data quality, compliance and consistency of master data.
* Identify, report and resolve data quality issues through root cause analysis.
* Support and implement data management methodologies that support KWS business initiatives.
* Participate in cross-functional projects and initiatives.
* Support in ad-hoc request from the team related to master data.

**Your Profile:**

* Enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Business Management, Finance, Supply Chain or any other related field, with **a minimum of 2 semesters left of studies;**
* Understanding impact of master data management – first experience in the area is a plus;
* Strong interest in Data Management;
* Proficiency in MS Office products, including advanced use of MS Excel. Power BI knowledge is an advantage;
* SAP experience is an advantage (PP module in S/4HANA);
* Proactive, structured, and an eye for details.
* Strong interpersonal, verbal/written communication and organization skills;
* Process-driven team player with customer-oriented service attitude;
* **Fluent English**, any other language is an advantage;
* Located in Berlin/Brandenburg.

**Our offer:**

* A thorough introduction to our processes;
* A location in the heart of Berlin;
* A positive and appreciative working environment;
* Flat hierarchies and open communication;
* Hybrid working possible (40% remote), attractive remuneration and flexible working hours to accommodate your studies;
* Insight into material and production master data management.

We look forward to receiving your online application via our application system SuccessFactors! Please use the "Apply" function in the online advertisement.

KWS is one of the world’s leading plant breeding companies and employs around 5,000 employees in more than 70 countries. With the tradition of family ownership, KWS has operated independently for more than 170 years. KWS uses leading-edge plant breeding methods and invests a significant amount in research and development.

At KWS, diversity is not just a value; it is an essential part of our success. Breeding resilient crops requires diversity; likewise, our strength comes from the diversity of our teams. Whatever your background or identity is, we invite you to join us.

Further information: www.kws.com/careers/. Follow us on LinkedIn® at https://linkedin.com/company/kwsgroup/.

title: Mandatory Internship – Product Development Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
**About ecopals**
-----------------

ecopals is building the leading performance additive platform for asphalt and bitumen modification, engineered for regional, sovereign supply chains and backed by strong unit economics. Our current product line is built on high-performance polymers, with further additive categories in active development. In the last two years, we have scaled to active operations in more than 10 EU countries, while continuously expanding our product and technology platform.

As we enter our next growth phase, we are opening a mandatory internship position for **Product Development Engineer (m/f/d)**. The role works closely with our R&D team on the identification, assessment and development of new products, formulations and production routes.

The role combines materials science and engineering with data analysis and modern AI-assisted technical workflows, with a strong emphasis on using these tools to accelerate development without compromising scientific rigor.

**Tasks**
---------

In this internship, you will help turn early technical ideas into structured development programmes and support the evaluation of which product and process routes are worth pursuing.

**Areas of responsibility**

* **Product development research.** Researching potential development routes for new products, formulations and processes based on scientific literature, technical documentation, experimental results and first-principles understanding.
* **Development-route assessment.** Comparing materials, technologies, mechanisms and production concepts and identifying promising routes for further development.
* **Technical and economic feasibility.** Preparing structured assessments and reports on technical feasibility, process requirements, raw materials, costs and potential economic viability.
* **Test programme development.** Supporting the design of experimental programmes, including formulation matrices, variables, testing methods and evaluation criteria.
* **Experimental and laboratory support.** Preparing material samples for internal testing, external laboratories and customers; assisting with the preparation and execution of in-house experimental setups; and supporting the documentation and evaluation of experimental results.
* **Laboratory coordination.** Supporting the planning and coordination of testing activities with internal and external laboratories, suppliers and technical partners.
* **Data analysis.** Processing and evaluating experimental data to identify trends, correlations, performance drivers and development priorities.
* **Technical data management.** Building and maintaining structured databases for formulations, raw materials, test results, literature and development projects.
* **Programming, data analysis and AI-assisted workflows.** Using Python and modern AI-assisted development tools, including AI agents, to clean, structure, analyse and visualize technical data; automate repetitive R&D tasks; support technical research; and build internal analytical workflows. A key part of the role is learning to use these tools effectively and responsibly, with proper validation, documentation and control of the resulting work.
* **Technical standards and regulations.** Researching and analysing standards, specifications and regulatory requirements relevant to products under development and their potential applications.
* **Technical reporting.** Preparing clear technical reports and decision documents that translate scientific, experimental and economic information into actionable development recommendations.
* **Independent development work.** Taking ownership of defined development questions and following them from initial research through analysis and experimental validation.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Currently completing a **Master’s degree or comparable advanced university programme** in **Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Materials Engineering, Process Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering** or a related field.
* Good foundations in **chemistry, materials science, construction materials and/or industrial processes**.
* **At least two years of relevant experience in one or more of the activities described above**, gained through internships, research projects, student assistant positions, laboratory work, industrial projects or professional experience.
* Strong analytical skills and confidence working with quantitative technical and experimental data.
* **Programming and data-analysis skills**, preferably with Python or comparable tools. Previous experience with AI-assisted coding or AI agents is valuable but not required. More important is the ability and willingness to rapidly adopt these workflows and use them rigorously — understanding what the tools are doing, checking their outputs, identifying errors and ensuring that analyses remain technically sound and reproducible.
* Ability to work systematically with scientific literature, experimental results and complex technical information.
* Ability to move between fundamental scientific questions and practical engineering and production constraints.
* A structured and independent way of working, with a strong sense of ownership.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; German is a plus.
* An entrepreneurial and pragmatic mindset, with genuine interest in developing technologies that can move from research into industrial application.

**Your Benefits**
-----------------

* **Direct involvement in product development**, contributing to technologies that may become future ecopals products.
* **Exposure to the full development process**, from scientific principles and formulation concepts to processes, testing and economic assessment.
* **Practical experimental experience**, supporting material preparation, in-house experiments and laboratory validation activities.
* **Hands-on experience with technical data and analytical tools**, including opportunities to improve how R&D data is structured, analysed and used for decision making.
* **Practical experience with AI-assisted R&D workflows**, including programming, automation and diligent use of AI agents as technical working tools.
* **Proximity to decision making**, working closely with R&D and company leadership on which development routes to pursue.
* **Responsibility from an early stage**, with ownership of defined technical work packages and development questions.
* **A steep learning curve** across materials science, chemistry, industrial processes, data analysis and applied R&D.
* **Practical exposure to industrial R&D**, including collaboration with laboratories, suppliers and technical partners.
* **Meaningful impact**, contributing to technologies designed to reduce emissions, improve circularity and increase the performance of critical infrastructure.

This position is a **mandatory internship**. A corresponding confirmation from your academic institution, stating the requirement to complete an internship, must be provided prior to the start of the internship.

Sounds like you? We look forward to receiving your application, including your CV and cover letter.

title: (Associate) Specialist, Commercial Intelligence
description:
Drive meaningful change
  
  
Data plays a key role in how we understand markets, identify opportunities, and make commercial decisions. As an (Associate) Specialist, Commercial Intelligence, you'll help turn complex data into insights that support our German business and contribute to improving access to medicine. Working closely with colleagues across the organization, you'll gain an understanding of our business while helping stakeholders make informed decisions based on data.
  
  
Get a glimpse of our world
  
  
You will join the Commercial Intelligence team within our German business unit, where you'll support commercial decision-making through data-driven insights and recommendations. The team serves as a dedicated analytical partner to the German organization, helping stakeholders better understand market developments, business performance, and commercial opportunities.
  
  
Working closely with colleagues across different professions, the team combines business understanding with analytical expertise to support both day-to-day decision-making and longer-term strategic initiatives.
  
  
Are you ready to embark on this journey with us?
  
  
As an (Associate) Specialist, Commercial Intelligence, you'll combine market knowledge with analytical thinking to help stakeholders make informed commercial decisions.
  
  
**Your Main Responsibilities Include**

* Conducting market, portfolio, pricing, competitor, and sales analyses to support commercial decision-making
* Monitoring market developments and business performance to identify trends, opportunities, and potential risks
* Developing and maintaining reports, dashboards, and KPI tracking to support the German organization
* Performing ad hoc analyses and business case evaluations to support strategic and operational initiatives
* Translating complex data into clear insights and recommendations for stakeholders
* Collaborating with colleagues across the German business and relevant support functions to drive data-informed decision-making
* Contributing to the continuous development of reporting, analytical frameworks, and data-driven ways of working

Fuel for your success in the role
  
  
We're looking for someone who is curious about how data can support better business decisions and motivated to develop both their analytical and commercial understanding. Whether you're at the beginning of your career or already have gained relevant experience, you enjoy working with data, solving problems, and translating findings into meaningful insights.
  
  
**To Succeed In The Role, We Imagine That You**

* Hold a relevant degree within business, economics, analytics, engineering or a similar field
* Have experience working with data, analysis, reporting, or business insights
* Possess strong Excel skills and are comfortable working with larger datasets
* Have experience with or an interest in SQL and Python
* Are familiar with BI and reporting tools such as Power BI or similar
* Communicate complex findings in a clear and understandable way
* Work in a structured manner and pay attention to detail
* Enjoy collaborating with stakeholders and building an understanding of business needs
* Are curious, proactive, and motivated to continuously learn and develop
* German language skills (written and spoken) are a plus.

Are you Interested?
  
  
If you want to apply for the position, please follow the link and attach your CV and cover letter.
  
  
Would you like to know more about us?
  
  
Follow us on Instagram and LinkedIn and get an insight into everyday life at Abacus Medicine. For job openings, check our Career page.
  
  
Moving Healthcare. Moving You.
  
  
In Abacus Medicine Group, you’ll experience the power of Moving Healthcare. With our change mindset, we're moving the industry and improving healthcare as we broaden access to medicine.
  
  
But it's not just about moving healthcare, it's about Moving You. You’ll be part of a caring community of more than 1,750 people across the World. With us, you will be valued, empowered, and have a direct impact on driving change. Let's access the future of medicine and make a difference together. Your move.

title: Product Manager - (Logistics, Service Automations)
description:
**Company Description**

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

 **Job Description**

We are on the lookout for a **Product Manager - (Logistics, Service Automations)** to join our **Logistics Service** team, where our mission is to increase loyalty through amazing service experiences.

In our **Logistics Team**, you’ll tackle high-impact challenges that make last-mile delivery efficient, affordable, and sustainable. Your work will directly improve experiences for riders, end customers, and merchants across the globe. Each enhancement you contribute will help Delivery Hero optimize delivery operations, supporting expansion into new areas like grocery and retail.

As a Product manager in our team, you will develop high-impact products that shape the future service experiences we offer to millions of customers, riders and vendors across Delivery Hero’s 60+ markets.

You will own the crucial steps of our support experience. When customers, riders, or vendors reach for help, they need access to easy ways to solve their issues. Your goal is to build user-friendly automations - from support with refund or missing items, to image validators - that help AI Agents understand what issue needs resolving.

You will lead the Service Action Automations squad. Your team focuses on the automation of common user issues - across customers, riders & vendors - that give more tools to our AI Agents and empower users to self-serve whenever possible.

* Own critical automations within our support journey - automations & image validation validators. Enable high-performing, autonomous AI Agents with your products.
* Balance user experience with protection of the business. We aim to make service effortless while preventing bad actors from exploiting our automation.
* Drive product and business metrics. You will own and improve squad KPIs, including automation rate, cost savings and fraud prevention.
* Balance new features with technical health. Ruthlessly prioritize your roadmap to improve the user experience while maintaining system reliability (loading times, error rates, and uptime).
* Collaborate with AI Agent squads to drive deeper, seamless integration of AI capabilities into the user flow.
* Align and influence multiple stakeholders across the organization without direct authority

 **Qualifications**

* 4+ years of product management experience in a cross-functional setup with a proven history of delivering results.
* Strong problem-solving skills. You can independently identify friction points in the user journey and execute solutions in close collaboration with designers and engineers. Master of work prioritization, with a strong grasp of technical trade-offs and opportunity costs.
* Data-driven mindset. You rely on data to make decisions and hold yourself accountable for driving specific user, product, and business metrics. Track record of measurably improving key metrics for existing products and successfully launching innovative new ones.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills. You use strong written and verbal communication to influence partners effectively and Fluent in english

Nice to haves:

* Experience working on Service tooling (Help Center, chatbots, Agent CRM, etc.).
* Experience working with AI/ML-driven products and features.
* Experience utilizing AI to reshape the way of working within their squad
* Proficiency in SQL, BigQuery, Firebase/Google Analytics, or Data Studio.
* Background in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Business Management, or Economics.

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

* We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
* We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.

title: Securities Operations Intern (f/m/d)
description:
**About Us:**

At Upvest, we are on a **mission to make investing as easy as spending money**. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by **€280M in total funding** from world-class investors, including **BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive**. Our latest **€105M funding round in March 2026** - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

**About the role:**

In 2027, Upvest is launching the **PEA (Plan d'Épargne en Actions)** on the French market with several leading fintechs. Within the Settlements & Transfers team, you will work across the full post-trade chain of securities account and PEA transfers: from instruction processing to settlement at Euroclear France, including relations with account keepers, custodians and issuers.

This internship offers **direct exposure to French and European post-trade operations** during a product launch, with real responsibilities from your first weeks.

**What you’ll do:**

* **Incoming and outgoing transfers:** Handle securities account (CTO) and PEA transfers with banks and brokers in France and across Europe, from receipt of the request to settlement of securities and cash.
* **Counterparty and client relations:** Ensure smooth communication with counterparties (banks, brokers, custodians) and our clients, and drive the follow-up of requests and reminders.
* **Controls and reconciliation:** Check securities and cash positions, reconcile movements with our custodian and analyse breaks.
* **Fails and exception management:** Investigate unsettled or rejected instructions, identify the root cause and coordinate resolution with counterparties and internal teams.
* **PEA tax continuity:** Review and record PEA tax statements (bordereaux d'information) to ensure the plan's tax history is fully preserved.
* **Registered shares:** Process operations on French registered shares (conversions, de/registrations).
* **Reporting and continuous improvement:** actively monitor SLAs and KPIs, write operating procedures and identify automation opportunities.

**What you bring:**

* **Education:** Master's degree (M1 or M2) in Finance, Banking, Economics or Law from a business school, engineering school or university; gap-year students and recent Master's graduates able to sign an internship agreement are welcome.
* **Languages: You have native-level or bilingual proficiency in French (C2) and are comfortable working in English.**
* **Experience:** A first experience in banking, back office, middle office or securities operations is a strong plus, as is knowledge of the PEA, post-trade or Euroclear France.
* **Analytical mindset:** Rigour, attention to detail and a taste for solving complex problems.
* **Tools:** You're confident with spreadsheets ; knowledge SQL/Python is a plus.

**How we Upvest in you:**

* **Impact-driven work:** We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.
* **Team celebrations:** Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.
* **Inclusion**: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem Black at Upvest, Up&Out, and UpVergent.

**Our Values:**

* **Make it easy for others.** We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions
* **Own the outcome.** We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.
* **Rise to the challenge.** We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.
* **Tell the story.** We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: (Junior) Growth Associate (m/f/d)
description:
We are on the mission to build Europe’s leading energy management platform **to provide fair, clean energy to everyone.**

We’re a diverse team of **50+ employees**, with **46% being female** and from **16+ nationalities**, and steadily growing. Having **raised of over €40 M** in total, we are looking for passionate people to join us on our mission!

Wir haben eine klare Mission: Wir bauen Europas führende Plattform für Energiemanagement, um **faire und saubere Energie für alle** zugänglich zu machen.

Unser Team ist vielfältig – wir sind über **50 Personen** aus mehr als **16 Nationalitäten**, mit einem **Frauenanteil von 46 %**. Und wir wachsen weiter!  
Mit über **40 Mio. € an Finanzierung** suchen wir nach motivierten Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns die Energiezukunft gestalten wollen.

**What You'll Do**

* Manage day-to-day operations and key account relationships with our sales partners, ensuring smooth collaboration and ongoing support
* Plan and coordinate sales campaigns with partners to drive customer acquisition and channel performance
* Manage the rollout of new offers & partners across the direct sales channel
* Improve existing processes, reporting, and performance tracking to make channel operations more efficient and scalable
* Support other acquisition channels and cross-functional growth initiatives as needed, acting as a versatile all-rounder within the Growth team **in Berlin**

  **What We're Looking For**
* 0–2 years of experience in Growth, Sales Operations, Business Development, Account Management, or a similar field (relevant internships or working student experience count!)
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and projects simultaneously
* An analytical mindset and confidence working with data, reporting, and operational processes
* A proactive, hands-on attitude with a strong sense of ownership and a willingness to take initiative
* A proactive mindset towards using AI and automation to improve efficiency, while being mindful of potential risks and limitations
* German Native and good English skills (C1/C2)

**About Us**
============

We’re Germany’s fastest-growing digital green energy provider and a Certified B Corp , driving the energy transition by making renewable energy more accessible and inclusive.

How? Through variable tariffs, dynamic pricing, smart EV charging, heat pump and solar optimization, and Germany’s first virtual power plant: NeoGrid.

At Ostrom, you’ll work in a dynamic, open environment where you can be yourself, take on challenges, and grow both personally and professionally.

**Environmental Impact:** Each customer who switches to Ostrom on average helps offset 1.5 tons of CO2 emissions per year compared to the average German energy mix.

**VSOP:** On top of offering a competitive salary you will have access to company shares to ensure you can truly be part of the journey.

**Trust-based Team**: A truly flat hierarchy and transparent company culture, where everyone’s voice matters.

**Benefits**: An annual learning budget, company-pension scheme, company events, discounted USC membership, discounted BVG public transport ticket, e-bike or e-moped, exclusive discounts via FutureBens or monthly vouchers - the choice is yours.

**Stay In The Loop:** We believe in transparent communication — from weekly town halls and quarterly updates to regular retrospectives. Got feedback or an idea? We’re all ears.

**Work Together, Celebrate Together:** We thrive on collaboration. Wins are shared and so are the celebrations from monthly happy hours to team trips and company events.

**Work Your Way:** Whether you prefer the office, your home desk, or a sunny spot in Sardinia — you work where you work best.

Wir sind der am schnellsten wachsende digitale Ökostromanbieter mit B Corp Zertifizierung in Deutschland – und treiben die Energiewende aktiv voran. Unser Ziel: Erneuerbare Energie für alle zugänglich und inklusiv machen.
